result.description: Fires on the token " development", mainly in "sustainable development" and similar modifier + development phrases (economic, inclusive). It stays silent on "the development of X" or "ongoing development" where no such modifier comes before it.
result.label: "sustainable development" development token

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ra' in the prefix "ultra" (ultra-fast, ultra-compact, ultra filters), weakly on intensifiers like ' very' and ' highly'. Silent on 'ra' in other words such as "unravel".
result.label: 'ra' in "ultra" prefix
Token ' so' as word start
result.description: Fires on the token ' so' (also ' So'), both as a standalone word and as a word-start piece in sovereignty, socio-, sociolects, soapy. Its logits favour continuations like 'cio' and 'vere'.
Fires on the token ' gate', both in quantum gates (CNOT gate) and in 'gatekeeping/gatekeepers' where the word is split. Members are mostly detectors of ' gate' at earlier layers.
result.label: ' gate' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' capital' when it begins a longer word, mainly 'capitalization/capitalisation', in text about writing, grammar and letter case. It predicts suffixes like 'ization', 'ized' and 'ise'. Weak on the financial noun.
result.label: ' capital' before -ization suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece "pher" in "atmospheric" (and sometimes "atmosphere", "apor"), in climate and atmospheric-science text. Weak on other earth-science words.
result.label: "atmos-pher-ic" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " liquid" (as noun or adjective, e.g. "liquid-solid", "liquid form") in science and chemistry text. Weakly also on "solvent". Members detect liquid, fluid and related word pieces.
result.label: ' liquid' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' qu' when it begins a split word such as quark, quilting, qubit or quenching. The contrast is knitting text without a split ' qu'. Upstream members are mostly ' qu' detectors.
result.label: ' qu' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' hole' / ' holes' right after 'black' in astrophysics text about black holes. Silent on vacuum/void text without 'black hole'. Members are detectors of black-hole context and of 'hole(s)' after 'black'.
result.label: hole(s) after 'black'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ynam' in words like Thermodynamics, Electrodynamics and Aerodynamics, after a prefix such as Thermod or Aerod. It is weaker on 'Mechan' in Statistical Mechanics.
result.label: 'ynam' in -dynamics words

result.description: Fires on the word " growing" used as an adjective meaning increasing, typically after "a", "the" or "their" before a noun such as demand or interest. Members detect growing, increasing and grow variants.
result.label: ' growing' as adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece 've' inside split words, mainly 'con-ve-' (convection, conveying, convective) and also 'conca-ve'. Predicts continuations like 'ction' and 'ying'.
result.label: 've' piece in convection/convey

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' integr' (also ' incorpor') when it is the start of a verb form like "integrating" or "incorporating", typically after "of" or "in". It is silent on "integr" in "integrals" or "integrates" after a subject.
result.label: ' integr' / ' incorpor' before -ating

result.description: Fires on the token ' steel' (e.g. stainless steel, steel sheets, iron and steel) in materials contexts. Weakly fires on other materials like coal or metal. Members detect steel, iron, metal and other material words.
result.label: steel token detector

result.description: Fires on " to" right after a predicate adjective like "fundamental", "essential" or "key" in a "X is fundamental to Y" construction. It stays silent on "essential to" followed by a verb (infinitive) and on other uses of "to".
result.label: "fundamental/essential to" preposition

result.description: Fires on the token " services" when it follows a preceding modifier noun, especially "streaming services". It stays silent when " services" starts the text with no preceding word. Members are mostly detectors of "services"/"service".
result.label: ' services' after a modifier noun

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a verb like "stands", "emerged", "serve" (stand as a testament, emerged as), where 'as' means "in the role of". It stays silent on "such as" and comparative "as ... as".
result.label: ' as' after stand/emerge/serve

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'er' (also 'es') right after 'coh' in "coherence/coherent", mid-word, when the word is being completed. Members detect 'coh' prefixes and 'er' pieces.
result.label: 'er' after 'coh' (coherence)

result.description: Fires on the token ' end' when it starts a word or compound (endogenous, endothelial, endangered, endpoints, end-group). It is most active in technical or scientific text and predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: ' end' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'la' / ' Gla' at the start of "glacial/glacier" words (e.g. a document-initial "Glacial ..."), predicting the continuation 'cial'. Silent on 'la' in unrelated words like "interlacing".
result.label: Gla- piece of glacier words

result.description: Fires on the word " tax" (or "Tax") mid-text, especially as a modifier or stem before "ation"/"es", as in "equitable tax", "sales taxes", "tax landscape". It is silent when "taxes" is the first token of the text.
result.label: tax token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'is' (Brava-is, Moll-is-ols), 'de' in attendees, and similar word fragments inside rare or multi-token words. Silent on 'is' in other words like cuisine.
result.label: Mid-word 'is'/'de' fragments in rare words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ab' in the middle of a longer word, mostly 'voc|ab|ulary' and also 'syll|ab|aries' and 'di|ab|etes'. Members are detectors of this 'ab' piece.
result.label: 'ab' inside vocabulary

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ency" completing words like transparency, consistency, coherency, mostly in abstract-noun or principles text. It stays silent on "ency" in "agency", so it needs the word-piece context.
result.label: "ency" suffix in transparency

result.description: Fires on the word piece " optim" (optimizing, optimism, optimizer) in mid-sentence, usually after a preposition or verb. Silent when it opens the document. Members detect optim/maxim/minimal-type stems that precede "-ize" suffixes.
result.label: ' optim' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ne' (neuro-, neural) in neuroscience terms, and on 'lect' inside 'thermoelectric'. It predicts continuations like 'uro'/'ure'. It stays silent on ' Ne' in 'NeoClassical'.
result.label: Ne- / lect- word-start fragments
'hel' fragment in helix/helium words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'hel' (as in helix, helices, helium, helicase) in scientific text, especially after 'alpha-' or 'helix-turn-'. Members are detectors of 'hel' and similar split-word beginnings.

Fires on the verb "require" (also requires/requiring), usually after a plural or abstract subject in technical or analytical prose, where an object like "careful/advanced/robust X" follows. Members detect require, need, involve and necessitate.
result.label: verb "require" detector
Hyphen after hands/eye compounds
result.description: Fires on the hyphen token after a first word like "hands", "eye" or "user", in technology and interface text (hands-free, eye-tracking, eye-based). It stays silent on hyphens after "self", "cross" or "le".
Fires on the piece 'our' inside "sourcing/sourced" (s-our-cing), where it continues the word and predicts -cing/-ced. It stays silent on 'our' in "flavour" and "gourmet".
result.label: 'our' in sourcing

result.description: Fires on the token " applications" (or " application") as a noun for uses of a technology or property, usually after modifiers like "wide", "practical", "industrial" in scientific or technical text. Predicts "such as" or "in" next.
result.label: ' applications' noun in technical text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " corpor" (start of corporate/corporation) in legal and business text. Silent on some instances after "international", so it may depend on the preceding word or context.
result.label: ' corpor' word piece (corporate/corporation)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ular' as a suffix inside words like secular, modular, intercellular and vernacular. It is weaker on 'circular'. The members mostly detect 'ular' or the preceding piece such as 'sec' or 'Mod'.
result.label: 'ular' suffix in words
'ten' inside Incompleteness
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ten' in "Incompleteness" / "Completeness" (Gödel's theorem), predicting a following 'ess'. It stays silent when 'ten' starts a text with no preceding word piece, so it needs the preceding "Incomple" / "Comple" piece.

Fires on adverbs and words (mostly, -ly, -ally, in, partially) that follow "composed" in "is composed entirely/mostly/partially of/in...". It needs the "composed of" construction; members detect "composed"/"consisting".
result.label: Modifier after "composed" construction

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer word, mainly ' deb' (before "t"), 'ness' in "harnessing", 'z' in "dozens", and 'nis' in "omniscient". It predicts a continuation of the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: deb, ness, z

result.description: Fires on the "'s" of "it's" and on "important"/"be" after "it is/it's/it'll", in impersonal evaluative frames like "it's important to". It stays silent on possessive "'s" after nouns.
result.label: Impersonal "it's important to" slot

result.description: Fires on ' service' right after 'customer' (customer service) in business text. It stays silent on 'service' in 'product or service' or 'after-sales service'. Members detect customer, loyal, and service tokens.
result.label: 'service' in 'customer service'

result.description: Fires on " spaces" (also " space") as the head noun of a mathematical space term, like Hilbert spaces, inner product spaces, vector spaces, null spaces. Weaker for other uses of the word.
result.label: Mathematical "spaces" after modifier

result.description: Fires on the verb ' benefit' after a subject (e.g. "sectors benefit", "Businesses can benefit"), where "from" is expected next. Weaker on 'benefits' and 'benefiting'. Silent on other text.
result.label: verb 'benefit' before 'from'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'du' inside words like trans-du-ction, trans-du-cer, and also ' dedu' and ' constru'. It predicts continuations such as 'cers' and 'ctions'. The peaks are mostly in transduction and signal-biology text.
result.label: 'du' piece in transduction
Sentence-opening Due/When/With and -building
result.description: Fires on ' Due' (and ' When', ' With', ' As') at the start of a document or sentence, and on 'building' in compounds like world-building. Mixed set of tokens; members detect 'building' and sentence-initial function words.
Fires on the word piece "aping" in "shaping" (sh+aping), as in "shaping policy" or "shaping human knowledge". Members detect shape/shapes/shaping forms and the verb sense of influencing.
result.label: "aping" in "shaping"

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a verb or preposition in technical/computing and science explanations (e.g. "decoding the", "for the", "includes the"), where a noun follows. Stays quiet on ' the' in abstract math/logic prose.
result.label: ' the' in technical explanations

result.description: Fires on the 'CD' piece in 'GCD' (greatest common divisor), and less on word-internal pieces like 'b' in 'herb', 'ance' in 'importance', 'ed' in 'heredity'. Mostly a word-piece detector for 'CD' after 'G'.
result.label: CD in GCD (word pieces)

result.description: Fires on the verb ' take' (also takes/taking), especially in "let's take" and similar verb uses. Members are mostly detectors of take-forms in earlier layers. The contrast text doesn't contain the token, so no extra condition is evident.
result.label: verb 'take' detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' across' when it follows a noun or verb and introduces a range of items (periods, cultures, regions), as in "changes across different periods". Strongest in science or academic text. Members are mostly ' across' detectors.
result.label: ' across' before a range of items

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' compet' (before itor/itive) and on ' Te' in the heading "Techniques", both incomplete word beginnings that need a continuation piece. Mostly business competitor text.
result.label: ' compet' and ' Te' word-starts

result.description: Fires on plural endings (-s, -isms, systems, programs, channels) of institutional/procedural nouns like protocols, mechanisms, systems in risk-management or policy text. Silent on possessive 's and on plurals in other contexts such as contracts.
result.label: Plural policy/procedure nouns (protocols, mechanisms)

result.description: Fires on the period after a single-letter middle initial in a person's name within lists of names (e.g. "James W." or "Guy D."). It stays silent on sentence-ending periods.
result.label: Period after name initial

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ens' when it starts a word like "ensures" or "ensembles", mid-sentence after a preceding word. It is silent when ' ens' begins the document, as in "ensured".
result.label: ' ens' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (and similar word pieces) when it completes a biology/molecular term such as "signaling" or "binding", especially after "signal". It stays silent on 'ing' in generic verbs like "discovering" or "maintaining".
result.label: -ing suffix in signaling/biology terms

result.description: Fires on a technical noun right after "and" in a coordinated pair of math/physics terms (e.g. "length and angle", "symmetry, and positive-definite"). Members are math-topic and "and"-list detectors. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Second noun in math term pairs

result.description: Fires on verb endings (-ize, -izing, -ing) or a verb like "present" in coordinated lists of verbs ("collect, analyze, and visualize"). Silent on -ize in other contexts like "prioritize rigorously" or "maximize".
result.label: Verb endings in coordinated verb lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece "hom" at the start of "homogeneous/homogeneity", most strongly in "non-homogeneous" (math, differential equations). Members detect "hom" and "ogeneous" pieces and the "non-" prefix.
result.label: "hom" piece in non-homogeneous

result.description: Fires on the 's' token as a contraction of "is" (it's, that's, who's), often before a predicate like "not" or "just". Stays silent on possessive 's after nouns or names (spider's, Milnor's).
result.label: Contraction 's (is), not possessive

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pie' when it starts "piezo-" words (piezoelectric, piezoelectricity, etc.), where the next piece is 'zo'/'za'. Its logits favour continuing the word. It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' pie' in piezo- words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pre' / ' Pre' when it starts a word split into pieces, such as "prepositions", "preprocessing", "prevalence" or "prefetching". It is silent on "prepose" and on the whole word "preposition" in some contexts.
result.label: word-initial ' pre' piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' exam' when it is the start of a verb form like "examining" or "examines" (e.g. "By examining"), expecting a suffix such as -ining or -ines. It stays silent on "examination".
result.label: ' exam' in examining/examines

result.description: Fires on " only" / " just" (also "solely") right after "not" in "not only/just X but also Y" constructions. Silent on sentence-initial "only" in inverted "only does/is" constructions.
result.label: "not only/just" intensifier

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a complementizer introducing a clause after a reporting/cognitive verb (demonstrated, shown, revealed, states, ensure). Silent on relative-clause ' that' after nouns (tool that, tasks that).
result.label: Complementizer 'that' after reporting verbs

result.description: Fires on the token 'red' as a standalone word or suffix (Barred, shredded, red spiral) and on ' before' in temporal clauses. Silent on 'red' inside 'ingredients'. Two unrelated tokens share it.
result.label: 'red' and 'before' tokens

result.description: Fires on verb endings or verbs (propels, empowers, drives, inviting, enables) where a causal/influencing verb takes a person-like object next, such as "us" or "readers". It pushes toward " us" as the next token.
result.label: Influence verbs awaiting an object

result.description: Fires on the word " expected", most strongly in the passive "X is/are expected to..." forecasting construction. It fires weakly on "expected return/value" and on "likely". Members are mostly detectors of "expected"/"expect".
result.label: " expected" in "is expected to"

result.description: Fires on the word " encryption" (and its piece "ryption") in text about cryptography, especially after "symmetric", "public-key", "for" or "categories of". Members are encryption, crypt and key/security detectors.
result.label: encryption word detector

result.description: Fires on the word "Urban"/"urban", especially as a heading or section-title start and before nouns like planning, development or sprawl. Members are urban/city detectors across earlier layers.
result.label: Urban token detector

result.description: Fires on a hyphen after a prefix-like fragment (e.g. "semi-", "beta-") and on the "et" inside "Non-Parametric", where a word is being continued. It stays silent on hyphens in ordinary compounds like "high-temperature" or on date ranges.
result.label: Hyphen after word-fragment prefix

result.description: Fires on adjectives describing defective or absent data, mostly " missing", also " irregular", " incomplete", " redundant", in data-cleaning and statistics text. It is silent on unrelated finance text.
result.label: missing/incomplete data adjectives

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces "Under"/"under" (Underfitting, Understanding, underneath) and some other word-start fragments like "Struct-ural", "scaff-", "ult-". Mostly a detector of the "under" prefix at word start, with a few similar beginnings.
result.label: Under- prefix and word fragments

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after emerge/develop verbs (emerging as, emerged as, developed as), introducing the role or status something becomes. Stays silent on 'act as', 'serve as', 'such as', and 'as emphasized'.
result.label: ' as' after emerge/develop verbs
Plural ' maps' after a modifier
result.description: Fires on the token ' maps' when it follows a modifying word, such as 'Thematic maps', 'Political maps' or 'distribution maps'. It stays silent when ' maps' starts the text with no preceding modifier. Members are map, mapping and cartography detectors.

result.label: 'ist' in whistleblower
result.description: Fires on the 'ist' piece inside "wh-ist-leblower" / "whistlebreaker" / "whistler", where the word is split into tokens. It stays silent on 'ist' as a suffix (reformist, industrialist) or in "twist".

Fires on ' are' (occasionally ' been'/' be') right after a plural subject noun such as "artists" or "engineers", before a verb or adverb. It stays silent after "which", "dishes", "practices" and "ingredients" in food and sustainability text.
result.label: ' are' after plural subject noun

result.description: Fires on forms of "become" (became, becomes, become), occasionally "seem", as the verb after a noun subject, where a change-of-state complement like "more complex" or "increasingly" follows. Members are detectors of become/becoming/grow.
result.label: Verb "become" after subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ener" inside "regeneration/regenerative" (also degenerate, green-er words), mostly in biomedical or engineering text. It predicts suffix continuations like "ative" or "ation".
result.label: "ener" in regenerative/regeneration

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after "is" in a copular construction naming the central or foundational element of something ("the heart of X is the…", "the key element of a menu is the…"). It stays silent on ' the' after prepositions or verbs.
result.label: ' the' after "X is" (core element)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' prem' (premise) and ' conclus' (conclusion) in logical reasoning text, plus 'red' in 'ingredient'. Silent when 'premises' starts the text, so it needs a preceding word in context.
result.label: Premise/conclusion word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' norm' (norms, Euclidean norm) and ' Equ' in "Differential Equations", i.e. an incomplete word piece awaiting a suffix, mostly in math contexts. Weak elsewhere.
result.label: ' norm' / ' Equ' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Vis"/" vis" (viscosity, viscous, viscometer, visually), where the next piece is expected to continue the word. Members are mostly detectors of " vis" and related word-start pieces.
result.label: Vis- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the verb " perform" (as in "can perform complex tasks", "to perform calculations"), mostly after "to" or "can" with a machine or system as subject. Predicts task or calculation objects next.
result.label: verb "perform" before tasks

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' coll' at the start of collider/collision in physics text. Upstream members mostly detect ' coll' itself; weak activation on other word-start fragments like 'aer-ob'.
result.label: ' coll' piece in collision/collider

result.description: Fires on the token ' order', strongest in the purpose phrase "In order to" at the start of a sentence. It fires less on "in order for" and on other senses of order (sequence, taxonomic rank).
result.label: ' order' in "in order to"

result.description: Fires on " on" after a noun, meaning "regarding/applied to" (accuracy on training data, indexes on documents, dialogue on...). It stays quiet after verbs like "working on", "based on", "rely on" and "information on".
result.label: ' on' after noun (technical)
Mid-word pieces in 'indispensable'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'isp' in "indispensable" (also 'il' in "fertilizers", and similar mid-word pieces). It needs to be inside those particular words, where the next piece is a fixed continuation such as 'ens'.

Fires on the token ' transaction' (also 'transactional', 'transactions'), mostly in technical or database text. It also fires weakly on 'ory' in 'allegory'. The circuit is mainly made of transaction-token detectors.
result.label: ' transaction' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " ones" used as a pronoun after an adjective or modifier (temporal ones, thicker ones, resistive ones), standing in for a previously mentioned noun. Silent on text without this construction.
result.label: Pronoun ' ones' after adjective

result.description: Fires on the prefix " non"/" Non" (non-linear, non-negative, Non-homogeneous), especially in technical or scientific text, often at a word or document start. Members are detectors of non and similar prefixes such as self, pre, cross and micro.
result.label: Non- prefix detector

result.description: Fires on the present-tense copula ' are' (sometimes ' is') right after a plural subject noun, especially an industry or group in a trend sentence ("chefs are turning to", "businesses are adopting"). Silent on 'are' inside subordinate or passive clauses.
result.label: Plural subject + 'are' in trend sentences

result.description: Fires on the end of a noun naming an examination or study, such as "examination", "analysis", "termination" and chemical "-ate", often right after a title-like opener and before "of". Peaks are mixed, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Analysis/examination noun endings before "of"
' cam' word-start piece (cameras)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cam' when it starts a split word, mainly 'cameras' (video cameras, film cameras, DSLR cameras). Members are detectors of ' cam' and similar word-start fragments like priv-, alt-, autonom-.

Fires on a word or word-piece right after "specific", "different" or "various", where a noun or word fragment is expected next (market, type, analyt-ical, disc-ourse). Silent on ' mole' in "molecular" after "the".
result.label: Word after specific/various/different

result.description: Fires on the nouns " orientation" and " direction(s)" as spatial or geometric concepts (vectors, gradients, angles, prepositions of direction). Members detect orientation, direction, axis, vector and degrees tokens. Weakly predicts " toward(s)".
result.label: orientation / direction nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece "cular" completing "molecular" (mole+cular, bimole+cular, intermole+cular), mainly in chemistry text. Members are mostly "cular" detectors plus a few detectors for the preceding "mole"/"mol" pieces.
result.label: "cular" in molecular

result.description: Fires on " banks" (also " bank") right after "central" in economic or monetary-policy text. It stays silent when " banks" begins the document with no preceding "central". Members detect bank/banks and economics words.
result.label: "banks" after "central"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ous" completing the word "ubiquitous" (after "ubiquit"), with weaker firing on "autonom-ous". The circuit's members detect "ous"/"ive"/"ence" word endings and "ubiquitous"-like pieces.
result.label: "ous" ending of ubiquitous

result.description: Fires on the word " shape" (also "shapes") in all its uses, mostly as a verb ("can shape our perception") but also as a noun ("octahedral shape"). Members are detectors of shape/shapes/shaping tokens.
result.label: ' shape' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " lack" (mostly the noun, as in "a lack of"), weakly on "satisf" and "lacking". Members are detectors of lack, absence, and without, which feed the target.
result.label: " lack" token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'oust' piece inside the split word "acoustic/acoustical" (ac-oust-ic). It is silent when 'oust' starts the text without the "ac" before it.
result.label: 'oust' in ac-oust-ic

result.description: Fires on ' not' directly after a noun subject (e.g. "approach not only enhances"), in the "not only" construction. It stays quiet after a verb or copula such as "is not" or "may not".
result.label: ' not' after noun, "not only"

result.description: Fires on ' are' as the main verb right after a plural subject noun that begins a definitional sentence (e.g. "plateaus are…", "grids are…"). It stays quiet for ' are' in relative clauses, after "and", or after some compound subjects.
result.label: ' are' after plural subject noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'arch' inside "hierarchy/hierarchical" (split as hier+arch). It stays silent on 'arch' in "anarchic", and members mostly detect 'arch' after hier-like prefixes.
result.label: 'arch' in hierarchy

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iter' inside "alliteration" / "alliterative", in writing about literary devices. Members are detectors of 'iter' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'iter' in alliteration

result.description: Fires on the piece 'etic' when it completes "kin" in "kinetic" (as in kinetic energy). It is silent on 'etic' at the start of a document with no "kin" before it. It also fires weakly on "kinematic".
result.label: 'etic' in "kinetic"

result.description: Fires on the token " peak" when it is used as a modifier in analytical chemistry/chromatography text (peak height, peak area, peak shape), predicting the next measurement word. Silent on the contrast text, which is about chemistry but has no "peak".
result.label: "peak" in chromatography measurements
Article ' an' after comma or sentence start
result.description: Fires on the article ' an' / ' An' (also 'Ancient' starts) when it begins a new clause or appositive, e.g. after a comma, semicolon or sentence break. It stays quiet on ' an' after a verb like 'see', 'provided', 'marking'.

Fires on the piece 'est' in the split spelling "a|est|hetic" (aesthetic/aesthetics), after the "a" piece. Silent on some other 'est' occurrences of the same word, so the dependence on context is partly unclear.
result.label: 'est' in split "aesthetic"

result.description: Fires on the token " research" (noun or modifier, often before "ers", "study", "design") in scientific or methodology text. Members mostly detect " research" itself, plus sample and experiment words.
result.label: ' research' token detector

result.description: Fires on passive past participles (supported, facilitated, hindered, backed) after a subject and auxiliary, where a 'by' agent phrase is expected next. Members detect participles like identified, accompanied, inspired, fueled.
result.label: Passive participle before 'by'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' necess' at the start of "necessitate/necessitating", typically after a subject or clause. Members detect similar word-initial pieces (facil-, pos-, exhib-, necess-) that precede "-it-" endings.
result.label: ' necess' in necessitate

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Sp"/" sp" when it starts a word split into pieces (oil sp-ill, Sp-aces, sp-elling, Sp-itzer). Silent on whole words like "Series". Predicts continuations such as -anning, -elling, -aces.
result.label: Split-word ' sp' / ' Sp' start

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'li' inside "unreliable" (also 're-li-able', 'appliances'), and weakly on ' Te' and similar mid-word pieces. Members are mostly detectors of 'li' as a token fragment.
result.label: 'li' piece in unreliable

result.description: Fires on the word " classic" used as an adjective before a noun (e.g. "a classic example", "classic literature"). Upstream members detect related words such as classical, traditional, conventional, famous and ancient.
result.label: Adjective " classic"

result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles ' a' and ' an' when they introduce a predicate or object noun phrase, often after verbs like "leaves", "providing" or "creating", or after "akin to". It is silent on 'a' after "just", "of" or "as".
result.label: Indefinite article a/an in object slot

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe that directly follows sentence-final punctuation (after a period) and begins a contraction-like "'s", "'ll" or "'re". It stays silent on apostrophes after a word, such as "it's" or "Let's", and on a leading apostrophe at the document start.
result.label: Apostrophe after sentence-ending period

result.description: Fires on the word " our" when it follows a verb or preposition such as "shapes", "shape", "framing" or "of", in abstract passages about human experience and cognition. Members are detectors of "our" and similar possessives.
result.label: "our" after verbs, abstract human experience

result.description: Fires on ' not' right after "Although" at the start of a document (concessive "Although not always..."). Silent on ' not' in other slots, such as after modals, "not only", or inside "notation".
result.label: ' not' after opening "Although"

result.description: Fires on verbs like "exhibit" (it), "display", "undergo", "experience" that follow a plural abstract subject and precede an expected object such as "remarkable differences" or "significant changes". Silent on "it" inside words like "geopolitical".
result.label: Exhibit/display-type verb after subject

result.description: Fires on the word " analysis" when it follows a modifier noun naming a method or data type, such as "data analysis" or "sentiment analysis". It stayed silent on "critical analysis" in the contrast.
result.label: ' analysis' after data/method noun

result.description: Fires on infinitive ' to' that introduces a verb after words like "ability", "able", "is", "how", "attempting", "expected". Silent on prepositional ' to' (similar to, listening to, with respect to) and after "not".
result.label: Infinitive 'to' before a verb

result.description: Fires on ' organized' (occasionally ' arranged') as a passive participle after a noun or 'is/are', as in 'elements are organized in...'. Members detect organized/ordered/arranged-type words.
result.label: ' organized' passive participle

result.description: Fires on the word " process", most strongly in "iterative process". It stays quiet after compound modifiers like "development process", "design process" and "response process", or when the word starts a sentence.
result.label: ' process' after "iterative"

result.description: Fires on the token ' search' (noun or verb, as in search engines, binary search, search costs, to search). Members are mostly detectors of ' search' at earlier layers. Contrast text lacks the word.
result.label: ' search' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ity" completing "divers|ity" (biological, genetic, linguistic diversity). It stays silent on "ity" in other words such as minority, vitality and humanity.
result.label: "ity" in "diversity"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " layout" (e.g. facility layouts, process layout), with a few hits on " break". Silent when "layout" opens the text with no preceding modifier noun. Members are mostly layout detectors.
result.label: ' layout' after modifier noun
Hydrolog-ical suffix piece
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ical' (occasionally 'or', 'ci') when it completes the split word 'hydrological'. It stays silent on 'ical' in ecological, analytical or geotechnical, so it needs the hydrolog- stem.

Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'io' (in raviolet, Dispositio) and 'rial' (in terrestrial, industrial), a word-piece in the middle of longer words. Members are detectors of these pieces and of word-start fragments.
result.label: Mid-word pieces 'io' and 'rial'

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'aren' inside the word "awareness" (aw|aren|ess), mostly after "raising/spreading/promote". Silent when the word is absent. Members are detectors of 'aren' and of similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'aren' in awareness

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' astronom' (astronomy, astronomers, astronomical) in every example. Members are mostly detectors of the same piece plus nearby science words such as atmos, galax and phys.
result.label: ' astronom' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' inside long digit strings (repeated zeros, decimals) and on the final '0' of decade years like 1940, 1980, 2030. Silent on '0' in forms like 20th or 1807, or in the middle of a year.
result.label: Digit 0 in numbers and decades

result.description: Fires mainly on " regardless" (usually after a comma, before "of"), with a few hits on " Right" in a list of Buddhist path factors and " Liv". Members detect words like without, even, equality, everyone, due and because.
result.label: " regardless" after a comma

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'omb' in Coulomb's Law and on ' absence', plus other word fragments (ro, ib). Mixed set of unrelated tokens; members are detectors of individual word pieces.
result.label: Coulomb 'omb' and 'absence' pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes like 'ular' mainly in "cellular", also 'mp' in Ampere and 'inger' in Schrödinger. Silent on 'ular' in "intercellular", so it seems to need 'ular' directly after "cell".
result.label: 'ular' in "cellular"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' exer' (the start of "exercises") in educational text, such as "listening exercises". Members are mostly detectors of the same piece, with a few other word-start pieces.
result.label: ' exer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ency' completing "consist|ency", mostly in computing text such as data or memory consistency models. It also fires weakly on similar pieces like 'Coher|ency' and 'conc|urrency'.
result.label: 'ency' in consistency

result.description: Fires on the word "Cloud"/"cloud", mostly in cloud computing contexts (e.g. "basics of Cloud Computing"), and also for weather clouds. Driven by upstream cloud-token detectors.
result.label: Cloud token detector

result.description: Fires on adverb-forming suffix pieces (-ally, -ically, -ibly) and ' locally' after a stem, especially in sustainability/food-sourcing text (environmentally, locally sourced). Silent on 'additionally' or a bare 'ally' at the start of a text.
result.label: adverb suffix -ally / locally

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'on' inside "Ionization" (I|on|ization), predicting a suffix like -ize. It stays silent on 'on' in words like phonon, phenomenon and photonics.
result.label: 'on' in Ionization

result.description: Fires on ' accounts' (as in "accounts for", "main accounts") and on ' Aug' at the start of "Augmented Reality". Members mostly detect account/accounts/reporting tokens. Weak activation on a few other nouns like energy and tongue.
result.label: accounts and Aug(mented) token

result.description: Fires on ' into' (also ' in') after an incorporated/integrated object, as in "incorporate X into their dishes". Silent on transformation "turn X into" or "delves into". Cooking and sustainability context members support it.
result.label: incorporate X into

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis ')' that ends a short parenthetical, variable argument, or list label such as (1), (d), C(n), especially in technical or math-like text. Silent on one N(x) example.
result.label: Closing parenthesis after short item

result.description: Fires on the word "cost"/"costs" as a noun in economics and business text, especially after modifiers like social, private, marginal, external or overhead. Members detect cost, price and overhead tokens.
result.label: cost/costs in economics text

result.description: Fires on the word " there" as an existential subject ("there is/are") right after an introductory clause and comma, or at a sentence start. Members are mostly detectors of " there".
result.label: existential " there" after clause

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis right after a full technical term or noun phrase (e.g. "Artificial Intelligence (", "Geographic Information Systems (") where an acronym or abbreviation is about to follow. Silent on parentheses after ordinary clauses.
result.label: Open paren before acronym

result.description: Fires on the word " weather" in meteorology and atmospheric-science text, usually as an object after words like "understanding", "forecast" or "predicting". Members are mostly detectors of "weather" and related words like meteor-, wind and climate.
result.label: ' weather' in meteorology text

result.description: Fires on the noun ' use' in the slot "[determiner/adjective] use of X", such as "innovative use of" or "The use of". It is silent on a bare sentence-initial ' use' verb, which has no preceding modifier.
result.label: noun 'use' before 'of'
'adr' in Quadratic
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'adr' in "Quadratic" (Qu|adr|atic), almost always in headings about quadratic residues or fields. It is silent on the fully spelled word "quadratic". Members mostly detect mid-word fragments.

Fires on the piece 'os' completing the word "chaos", mostly in "chaos theory" or chaos as a mathematical or physical concept. Members are mostly 'os' detectors. It is weakly active on other word-final pieces.
result.label: 'os' ending "chaos"

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after a noun naming a product, method, process or therapy (insulin for, therapies for, processes for), introducing its purpose. Silent on ' for' after adjectives like 'essential' or some other nouns.
result.label: ' for' after purpose noun

result.description: Fires on the word " Fair"/" fair", mostly capitalized, in fair trade and fair prices contexts, where the next word is likely "trade". Members are detectors of "fair" and "trade" tokens.
result.label: "Fair" in fair trade

result.description: Fires on the noun meaning result or consequence, mainly the "lications" piece of "implications", and also "effects", "consequences" and "importance". It usually comes before "of" or "for". It is silent on one "implications" example that follows "broad".
result.label: Implications / consequences / effects nouns

result.description: Fires on 'friend' in hyphenated compounds like "user-friendly" and "eco-friendly", and more weakly on hyphens in compounds like "decision-making". It needs the hyphenated compound-modifier slot, before a suffix like "-ly".
result.label: friend in hyphenated compounds

result.description: Fires on the noun ' shift' meaning a change or transition (e.g. "a shift towards", "the shift from"). Members detect ' shift' and related words like transition and change. It is silent when ' shift' starts a text with no preceding context.
result.label: noun 'shift' (change, transition)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' St' at the start of a word or heading, mostly the ' St' of "Stellar" at a document or section start, and more weakly on pieces like 'ural'. Members are mostly ' St' detectors. Predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' St' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on " of" right after a period or named-thing noun such as "Age" (Age of Enlightenment/Discovery), weaker for "Wars of Religion" and "Wealth of Nations". It stays silent on "of" after ordinary nouns like "portion" or "end".
result.label: "of" in "Age of ..." titles

result.description: Fires mainly on " structures"/" structure" in civil-engineering contexts (safety, loads, foundations, buildings), plus a few odd word-piece peaks like " Res" and "loc". Silent on a sentence-initial " structures" lacking engineering context.
result.label: Engineering 'structures' noun

result.description: Fires on 'rock' in 'bedrock' used metaphorically as a foundation, and more weakly on 'stone' in 'cornerstone' and 'ar' in 'pillar'. Needs the foundation-metaphor word piece, not generic text.
result.label: bedrock / cornerstone foundation metaphor
' focus' and abandon/Ex word starts
result.description: Fires mostly on ' focus' (also 'abandon', 'Ex', 'ly' in glycogen, 'foc-al') as noun or word start, often early in a passage. Silent on one 'traditional focus is on' example, so the condition is unclear.
Fires on the piece 'ot' in "homotopy" (hom|ot|opy), in algebraic topology text. It is silent on unrelated contexts, and weakly fires on ' binary' and 'vit' in other words.
result.label: 'ot' in homotopy

result.description: Fires on the word ' civil' (as in civil rights, civil disobedience, civilization), mostly as a standalone word before 'rights' or as the start of 'civilization'. Members are mostly ' civil' token detectors.
result.label: ' civil' token detector

result.description: Fires on "development" or "evolution" (also "growth") as the head noun right after "The" at the start of a document/title, as in "The evolution of…". It stays silent when the word follows a modifier like "plot", "urban" or "conceptual".
result.label: Sentence-initial "The development/evolution"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' em' as a prefix at the start of a word like embrace, empathize, emissions, emotion, mostly after a verb or preposition. Silent on some ' em' contexts such as after a noun or at the start of a sentence.
result.label: ' em' word-start prefix
Plural 's' after acronyms
result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 's' attached directly to an all-caps acronym (MGFs, LSTMs, DAGs, RBMs) in technical text. Stays silent on verb 's' endings and on possessive apostrophe-s.
Fires on the word piece ' cor' when it begins "corrosion" (also weakly "corrupt"), in materials and corrosion-types text. Members are mostly ' cor' token detectors across early layers.
result.label: ' cor' start of corrosion

result.description: Fires mainly on " instant" (as in "instant messaging", "instantaneous"), and weaker on "three-" hyphen and "best". Members detect instant, simultane-, spont- pieces, predicting word continuations like "-aneous". Silent on "instant" at document start.
result.label: "instant" before messaging/-aneous

result.description: Fires on ' order' as a noun after "the" (the order of reaction, order of arrangement, group order, taxonomic order). Silent on "second order" and on "in order to".
result.label: noun 'order' after "the"

result.description: Fires on the word " speech" (occasionally " voice") in speech-technology text such as speech recognition, synthesis and analysis. Members are detectors of speech, spoken, audio and pitch tokens. Silent on unrelated AI text.
result.label: speech (recognition/synthesis) token

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after a need/demand-type noun ("the need for", "demand for", "respect for"), where a noun phrase follows. Silent on ' for' in other uses like "for instance" or "used for".
result.label: 'for' after need/demand nouns

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " en" that begins a longer word (enzyme, envelope, enabling, enrichment, encompasses). Members mostly detect " en" itself. The contrast has no " en" token, so it stays silent.
result.label: ' en' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis ')' that ends a short parenthetical, often a variable, index, label or single word like "(n)", "(1)", "(þæt)". Silent on ')' closing a longer phrase.
result.label: Closing parenthesis after short item

result.description: Fires on ' against' (also across/among) right after "performance" or similar nouns in comparison/benchmarking contexts, as in comparing performance against standards. Quiet in unrelated marketing text.
result.label: Performance compared 'against' benchmarks

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' in "Descriptive", especially the heading "Descriptive Statistics". It stays silent on 'ive' in other words such as objective, intuitive, collective and predictive.
result.label: 'ive' in "Descriptive"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' compar', ' Compar', ' hy' (hyphenation, hybridization) and similar, when the word is split into pieces and continues (comparative, comparisons). Silent on 'comparable' in one contrast.
result.label: compar- / hy- word-start fragments

result.description: Opening quote mark (' "') that starts the next item in a quoted list of words, e.g. "to," "from," or "my", "your". Silent on quotes that open a single phrase, not a list.
result.label: Opening quote in quoted word lists

result.description: Fires on the word " physical" itself, mostly in philosophy of mind passages (mental vs. physical, physicalism, dualism). Weaker in other uses like physical experiences or the digital world. Supported by members detecting " physical" and philosophy-of-mind context.
result.label: ' physical' in mind-body philosophy

result.description: Fires on the verb ' express' (also 'ing' in conveying/expressing) after "to/can" when artists or art forms are the subject, as in "allows artists to express themselves". It stays silent on the adjective "expressive".
result.label: Artists to 'express' (verb)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "engine" (or " engine") as the start of words like engineer/engineering, and in compounds like steam-engine. Members are mostly detectors of "engine" and similar word-start pieces that continue into -ers/-ering.
result.label: engine token (engineer/engineering)

result.description: Fires on the infinitive marker ' to' right after verbs of striving or intent such as "sought to", "seeking to", "attempt to", "aim to". It stays silent on ' to' after "response", "helped", "began" or "means".
result.label: ' to' after seek/attempt verbs

result.description: Fires on ' the' after passive or causal verb phrases like "founded on", "supported by", "dictated by", "influenced by", "born from", in abstract or scientific explanation. It stays quiet on ' the' after verbs like "emphasizes" or "highlighting".
result.label: ' the' after "by/from/on" explanatory phrases

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' surv' (survive, survival, survivor), mainly after "for", "to" or "of". Members are mostly detectors of ' surv' and similar word-start pieces like arch, rev and ach.
result.label: ' surv' word-start piece
' perce' word-piece before -ive/-ived
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' perce' at the start of "perceive/perceived", predicting the suffix 'ived'/'ives'. Weakly fires on similar incomplete word starts like ' benef'. Members are detectors of ' perce' and similar prefixes.

Fires on the word piece 'cient' in "Ancient" (headings like "Ancient Maya/Egypt"), and more weakly on ' primitive', ' ancient', and 'sc' in "microscopy". Members are detectors of 'cient' and ancient-civilization names (Sumer, Babylon, cuneiform).
result.label: Ancient / 'cient' in ancient civilizations

result.description: Fires on word stems or pieces in mid-word position (launch, contract, Perform, Decomm-ission, Vol-unte) where a suffix like -ing, -ual, or -er is expected next. Silent on whole-word list items in headings.
result.label: Stem before suffix completion

result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' inside the name "Mycenae/Mycenaean" (My|c|enae). It stays silent on 'c' in other words like "showcased" or "cuneiform", so it needs that specific word.
result.label: 'c' in Mycenae
' compreh' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compreh' at the start of "comprehension", "comprehending" and "comprehensive". Members are mostly detectors of this same piece, and the target pushes toward continuations like "ension" and "ensive".
Fires on the plural noun " signs" (also " signals") in a variety of contexts, such as street signs, smart signs and disease signs. Members are mostly detectors of signs/signal/marker tokens.
result.label: ' signs' / ' signals' token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' develop' when it follows a modifier like "recent", "new", or "technological" and is the start of "developments". It is silent when ' develop' starts the text. It predicts the suffix 'ments'.
result.label: ' develop' in "developments"

result.description: Fires on the word " price" (also Price) in economics text, often as a modifier before another noun, as in "price controls", "price changes" or "low price sensibility". Members are price/pricing detectors. It is silent on "price war" at the start of a text.
result.label: ' price' as economic modifier

result.description: Fires on ' in' (or sentence-initial ' In') when it starts a new clause or list item after a semicolon, comma or period, introducing a field or context ("; in economics", "In essence"). It stays silent on ' in' mid-phrase after a noun or verb.
result.label: Clause-initial " in" after punctuation

result.description: Fires on ' silent' and on the word piece 'ore' inside words like chemoreceptors, thermoreceptors and offshore, plus some other mid-word pieces. It is silent on 'ore' in other words such as 'plore'.
result.label: ' silent' and 'ore' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the first word right after "involves/involve/involved", the start of the activity described (e.g. manipulating, engaging, dividing). It predicts a verb-stem continuation, often -ing forms. It stays silent on "act" in "active listening" where no "involves" precedes.
result.label: Word right after "involves"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like 'U' (UX, UAT, matrix U), ' rom' in romantic, and ' Sc', where the token starts a word or abbreviation that continues with a further piece. Mostly 'U' tokens across UX and math contexts.
result.label: Initial 'U' / 'rom' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " performance" (also "Performance" and the piece "formance"), mostly in technical text about systems, databases and computing efficiency. Built from upstream detectors of the same word. Predicts continuations like "tun(ing)".
result.label: ' performance' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' avail' (start of "availability") before the "-ability" suffix is completed. Members detect avail, -ability, and similar stems like cap-, toler-, scarc-. Predicts suffix completions such as "ability".
result.label: ' avail' stem before -ability

result.description: Fires on word-suffix pieces ('ical', 'ing', 'ed') directly after the stem 'graph' (graphical, graphing, graphed). Stays silent on 'ical' after other stems such as analyt-, ecolog-, Mathemat-.
result.label: Suffix after 'graph' stem

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'er'/'ers' ending "Polym(er)" as a complete word in title-like lists of science or engineering fields, or in plural "polymers". It stays silent when 'er' is mid-word, as in "polymerization" or "polymeric".
result.label: Polymer word-final 'er' suffix

result.description: Fires on " the" right after "without" (also weakly "avoid the", "without any"), where a noun like "need" or "subtle hint" is expected. Silent on "the" after other prepositions or verbs.
result.label: "the" after "without"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' emer' (emergence, emergent, emergency, emerged), where the next piece is likely 'gent', 'ging' or 'ges'. Members are mostly detectors of the same ' emer' token.
result.label: ' emer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the 'ern' piece in 'modern' when split, as in postmodernism, and on ' modern' or 'Contemporary' used as a period or style word in arts and literature text. Predicts continuations like 'post' or 'conscious'.
result.label: 'modern' word piece (postmodernism)

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in the contraction "don't" (also doesn't, didn't, isn't), after a "don"/"n" stem. Silent on apostrophes in "it's", "there's", "'ll" or possessives.
result.label: Apostrophe in don't-type negations

result.description: Fires on the word " internet" (also " Comput" in "Cloud Computing") when it modifies a following noun, as in "enable internet services" or "high-speed internet". It stays silent when "internet" starts a text before "'s".
result.label: ' internet' as modifier word

result.description: Fires on the token ' experience' (or 'experiences') as a noun after a modifier such as dining, guest, culinary, or immersive. Members are mostly ' experience' token detectors. The contrast text has no such word.
result.label: ' experience' noun after modifier
'hard' in Leonhard (name piece)
result.description: Fires on the token 'hard', mostly as the ending of the name Leonhard (Euler). Weaker on other 'hard' pieces such as Hardware, and on ' Middle' in 'High Middle'. Members detect 'hard' and Leon-/Bern- name pieces.

Fires on the 'odes' piece inside "geodes-" words (geodesy, geodesists) after "ge", with members tracking geodesy word pieces (Geodetic, longitude, geoc-). Silent on a word-initial 'odes'. Also weakly on other word fragments.
result.label: 'odes' in geodesy words

result.description: Fires on ' and' (rarely ' or') joining two short parallel nouns or names, like "double and single", "HR and senior", "Spanish and Portuguese". It is quieter on 'and' after longer noun phrases or in lists.
result.label: ' and' between paired nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " same", mostly in "the same X" phrases that state identity or equality of things (same pressure, same memory, same atomic number). Members are mostly " same" and "identical" detectors.
result.label: " same" after "the"

result.description: Fires on degree adverbs like " mostly", " largely", " relatively", and the suffix "ly" in "Eco-friendly", typically after "made up", "due", or "consisting". Members detect mostly/mainly/partly and -fully/-ically adverb endings.
result.label: Degree adverbs: mostly, largely, -ly

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'lo' in "overexploitation" and 'aren' in "awareness", where a word is split into pieces. Seems to need those specific words; silent on other text about resources.
result.label: Mid-word 'lo' in overexploitation

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lacement" completing "displacement", mostly in physics/kinematics text. Members detect the "lacement" token and related suffix pieces like "ment" and "ersion" after "disp".
result.label: "lacement" in displacement

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ra' in "infra" as the word "infrared" is being spelled out (inf|ra|red). Silent when 'ra' starts a fragment without the preceding "inf". Weakly fires on other "inf-" word pieces.
result.label: 'ra' inside "infrared"
' potential' before risk/threat nouns
result.description: Fires on the word ' potential' as an adjective, mostly in risk and security text (identify potential threats, potential harm). It pushes the next token towards risk, threat, loss and harm words. Members are mostly ' potential' detectors.

Fires on ' as' used as a conjunction meaning "while/because" after an adjective like "increasingly important/common/relevant" (e.g. "becoming important as technology advances"). Silent on "such as" and "serve as".
result.label: ' as' conjunction after "increasingly important"

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'y' (also 'ancy', 'ing') completing the verb "occupy"/"occupancy", mostly in physics text about electrons occupying states. Silent on 'y' ending other words like flinky, shadowy, tragedy.
result.label: 'occupy' word-ending y

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "early" (e.g. "early on", "early as", "early form", "early explorations"), with "early" as the preceding context. It is silent on " on" after other words like "research on". It predicts stage/period continuations.
result.label: Token following "early"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that begin a longer word, mainly ' resid' (in "residues"), also ' diag', ' indic', ' quot'. Predicts suffix pieces like 'ue', 'uals', 'ding'. Evidence is mixed across several prefixes.
result.label: Word-prefix fragments: resid, diag, indic

result.description: Fires on the 'ving' piece in "evol-ving" (also "ch-anging", "evol-ve"), especially in "constantly/ever evolving". It stays silent on 'ving' in "improving", so it needs the evolve word.
result.label: 'ving' in "evolving"

result.description: Fires on " non" as a prefix, mostly in "every/all/each non-key (prime) attribute" in database normalization (2NF), and in technical math/CS text with "non-" terms. It predicts mathematical nouns like element or subgroup.
result.label: "non" prefix in technical text
Jac in Jean-Jacques Rousseau
result.description: Fires on the piece 'Jac' in "Jean-Jacques", as in Jean-Jacques Rousseau, in lists of Enlightenment philosophers. Members include a ' Jean' detector, 'Jac' detectors, and philosophy-context members.
Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'osp' in "Geospatial", also ' conf' in "confined/confinement" and 'dom'. Predicts word continuations like 'atial' and 'aces'.
result.label: Word-piece 'osp' in Geospatial

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mainly ' vol' (volcano, volatility) and ' pot' (potatoes), also ' pill' and ' pal'. It predicts the continuation piece of the word.
result.label: Word-start fragments vol/pot

result.description: Fires on the isolated piece 'e' in numbered/hyphenated sequences (2e-3e-5e) and after prefixes like macro-, micro-, socio-, in-, where 'economic', 'efficiency' or 'evolution' would continue. Predicts 'conom', 'vol', 'ffic'.
result.label: 'e' piece before conom/vol continuation

result.description: Fires on the 'p' piece inside a split word, mainly 'trans' + p + 'iration' (also 'cas-p-ase'), where a following completion like 'iration' or 'ase' is expected. It stays silent on 'p' in 'Precipitation'.
result.label: 'p' inside trans-p-iration

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "start" or "beginning" (e.g. "marking the start of"), in the sense of the onset of something. It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "end", "adoption" or "wave".
result.label: " of" after start/beginning

result.description: Fires on the token ' us' (pronoun or word start as in 'usable/usability') and on ' chron' in 'chronology'. It fires on these word pieces that typically continue into a suffix, mostly ' us' after verbs like allows, help, challenge.
result.label: ' us' and ' chron' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ron' inside words like electron, microelectronics, acronym, mostly after 'elect'/'ac' pieces. Occasionally fires on ' Friedrich' in 'Carl Friedrich'. Members are detectors of 'ron'/'ric' pieces in electronics words.
result.label: 'ron' in electronics words

result.description: Fires on the words " left" and " right" (direction or side, including "left out", "left over"), across rotation, position and abstract uses. Members are mostly detectors of left or right. Silent on the contrast, which has no such word.
result.label: left / right direction words
Supply chain topic word continuations
result.description: Fires on word pieces following "Supply Chain" in lists of supply chain subtopics (W-arehousing, Returns, Pro-curement, Forecast-ing). Members detect "chain" pieces. Silent on "management" in other resource/asset contexts.
Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "questioning" (question + ing). It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs like challenging or highlighting.
result.label: 'ing' in "questioning"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ton' at the end of the name Dalton (and similar names like Bray-ton, Proton), mainly in science text. It stays silent on a misspelled name like "Datson".
result.label: 'ton' ending of Dalton

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " input" (as in input/output devices, input data), with a few hits on "vex"/" convex". Members are mostly detectors of " input" and related tokens such as feedback and output. Next-token logits favour " out" and "-".
result.label: ' input' token detector

result.description: Fires on commas separating items within a list of examples or terms (e.g. "who, what, which", "my, your, his, her"), mostly in text about grammar or enumerated concepts. Silent on commas after sentence-initial adverbs or conjunctions.
result.label: Comma inside enumerated lists

result.description: Fires on the word " work" (and " works"), most strongly as the physics quantity "work done by a force" in work-energy contexts. Weaker on workplace or verb uses. Members are mostly detectors of " work" itself.
result.label: ' work' token, physics sense

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' dr' (drilling) and ' surve' (surveying/surveillance) in technical text, predicting suffix pieces like 'ational', 'ill', 'iling'. Weakly on similar stems such as 'situ' and 'gravit'.
result.label: dr-/surve- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on function words (with, on, to, when, a, for, of) right after a verb or adjective in the opening of generic essay-style documents about writing or brands, where a complement comes next. It is silent on many 'with' tokens, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words after verbs in essays

result.description: Fires on ' on' (and ' upon') right after reliance/dependence words such as "reliant", "dependent", "relying", "depend upon". It stays quiet on ' on' after other words like impact, focus or constraints.
result.label: on/upon after depend/rely words

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'x' in "nexus" (also 'pect' in "Aspect"), a word fragment within a longer word. Members are mostly 'x' detectors, including the variable x in math. Silent in ordinary text.
result.label: 'x' inside "nexus" word piece

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a verb of labeling or viewing (labeled as, viewed as, regarded as, known as, deemed as), introducing how something is characterized. Silent on 'such as' examples.
result.label: 'as' after labeling/viewing verbs

result.description: Fires on the token ' smart' used as a modifier in compounds like smartphone, smart home, smart appliances, and predicts product-like continuations (watch, phone). Members are mostly ' smart' token detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' smart' as tech modifier

result.description: Fires on capitalized function or word-start tokens (The, To, Under, What, About) inside Title Case headings or titles, where each word is capitalized. Silent on ' The' starting an ordinary sentence in normal-case prose.
result.label: Function words in Title Case headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ual' inside longer words, such as concept-ual, fact-ual, mut-ual, habit-ual and grad-ual. It is followed by suffixes like -ized, -ism or -ity. Members mostly detect 'ual' itself.
result.label: 'ual' suffix piece in words

result.description: Fires on 'silent' and the piece 'ent' when it completes "Silent" (Silent Way/Method), plus 'ently'. It stays quiet on 'ent' in other words such as "inherent".
result.label: Silent / Sil-ent word

result.description: Fires on verbs of translating or interpreting input (interpre-ting, translated, interpret, understood), especially about source code or data being converted or read. Predicts data/input-like objects. Silent on "typesetting".
result.label: Interpret/translate verbs on code or data

result.description: Fires on the word piece " stream" when it begins a compound like "streamline" in fluid-dynamics text. It predicts continuations such as "lined" or "lines". Weak activation on "hand" in "on the other hand".
result.label: ' stream' before -line compounds

result.description: Fires on the word " possible" (also "possibility", weaker "potential"), mostly as a modifier in modal-logic or probability text such as "possible worlds" or "all possible outcomes". Silent on the surrounding modal-logic text without the word itself.
result.label: "possible" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " size" as a noun in technical or scientific text (particle size, sample size, set size, effect size). Members are mostly detectors of " size" plus similar measurable-property nouns like name and rank.
result.label: Noun ' size' detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'it' in "vitational" (gravitational, garbled), and some 'ul', 'ag', 'ist' pieces. Silent on 'it' in ordinary words like exhibit, merit, necessitates. Appears tied to rare or split word pieces.
result.label: Word-piece 'it' in split "vitational"

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment inside a longer capitalized proper name or academic term (Princi-ple, Hell-enistic, Am-pere, Pos-itivism, existenz-ialism). It needs the word to be unfinished, not a common word like "ample".
result.label: Mid-word piece of academic proper names

result.description: Fires on the word "print" and its variants (printing, Print, printed), mostly in printmaking and printing-press contexts. Members are mostly print-word detectors. Weak firing on "ec" is a minor edge case.
result.label: print / printing token

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' sp' (spelling), ' ph' (phonetic), ' hom' (homophones) in text about language, linguistics and grammar. Predicts continuations such as 'elling' or 'ambigu'. Quiet on non-linguistic topics.
result.label: Linguistic word-start fragments (sp, ph, hom)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'sp' in "unspoken" after the prefix "un", predicting the continuation "oken". Silent on other un- words like "unscripted". Weakly fires on other word-start fragments.
result.label: 'sp' in "unspoken"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' phenomen' (start of "phenomenology"/"phenomenological") in philosophy-style titles and phrases. Members are mostly detectors of phenomen/phen/omen pieces. Silent on the contrast text, which lacks that token.
result.label: ' phenomen' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word "proof"/"proofs" in mathematical or logical text, especially in lists of proof techniques (direct proof, proof by contradiction). Members include proof-token detectors plus math-context members such as metric spaces and algebra.
result.label: "proof" in mathematical contexts

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "coh" (er, es, om) when completing "coherent/coherence/cohesion/cohesive". Silent on "er" in other words like "richer".
result.label: Suffix piece after "coh-"

result.description: Fires on " early" (and " earliest") after "the" when it means an early period or stage, e.g. "the early 19th century" or "the early Neolithic". It stays silent on "as early as", "and early", and "to early" before dates.
result.label: "the early" period/stage modifier

result.description: Fires on the middle pieces 'ney' or 'ne' in the split word "kidney(s)", after the ' kid' token, in biology and medical text. The contrast (a "filter" metaphor without the word kidney) stays silent.
result.label: kid-ney word piece

result.description: Fires on " how" introducing an embedded clause after verbs of examining or explaining (exploring, examining, showing how...) in academic, analytical prose. Members are mostly detectors of how/why/where/whether.
result.label: "how" after examine/explore verbs

result.description: Fires on forms of "lead" (leading, led, lead), most strongly on "leading/led to" expressing causal consequence, as in "temperatures rise, leading to...". Members are detectors of lead/led/leading tokens.
result.label: Causal "leading/led to"

result.description: Fires on the adverb ' carefully' (weakly on other manner-adverb endings like -ically/-fully), usually before a verb such as choose, select or observe. Pushes toward verbs and participles like selected or task.
result.label: ' carefully' adverb detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "os" inside science words split into pieces, most often "nucle|os|ynthesis" and also "chrom|os|omes". It needs the "nucle-" or "chrom-" prefix context in technical science text.
result.label: "os" in nucleosynthesis-type words

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces " infl" / "fl" in "inflation", "inflaton", "inflammation", strongest in cosmic inflation contexts, and predicts "ation" next. Also weaker for economic inflation. Silent on unrelated cosmology text lacking this piece.
result.label: infl- word start (inflation)

result.description: Fires on the time-span noun ' years' (also decades, centuries, months) in durations like "for hundreds of years" or "for many years". Upstream members detect time-unit words in lists of durations.
result.label: Duration unit 'years'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' def' (mostly in "deficit"), where the word continues with further pieces. It predicts suffix pieces like 'ies', not a whole word. Members are mostly ' def' detectors plus other word-start fragment detectors.
result.label: ' def' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' printing' (3D printing, offset printing, printing press), mostly after a modifier noun. Members are detectors of print/printing/press tokens. Silent on 'print age' in the contrast text.
result.label: ' printing' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ed' completing the word "targeted" (e.g. targeted gene editing, targeted therapy). It stays silent on 'ed' in other verbs like highlighted or broadened.
result.label: 'ed' in "targeted"

result.description: Fires on the token " Bell" as a surname or name piece, most strongly in "Bell Numbers" in math text. Members are mostly detectors of " Bell" itself. It weakly fires on word pieces like "ce" in "oceans".
result.label: Bell name token (Bell numbers)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ced' inside words like "antecedent" (also "unprecedented", "Procedures"). It stays silent on 'ced' at the end of "reinforced". Members detect 'ced' and 'ante' pieces.
result.label: 'ced' in antecedent

result.description: Fires on " Model" (occasionally " Standard") in the phrase "Standard Model" of particle physics, including Supersymmetric Standard Model. Supported by cosmology and particle-physics context members and "Standard" detectors.
result.label: Standard Model (physics) token

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ag' (also 'agn', 'abil') in the middle of multi-piece words like reim-ag-ining, st-agn-ant, pl-ag-iarism, where a suffix is expected to follow. Silent on whole-word uses.
result.label: 'ag' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " academic" (adjective before a noun such as programs, standards, disciplines, life). Upstream members detect academic/educational/scholarly word pieces. Silent on the contrast text, which has no " academic" token.
result.label: ' academic' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ic' and 'ics' at the end of "Econom-" in economics headings or topic lists (e.g. "Public Econom|ics"). It stays quiet on 'ic' in other words such as Ethnomusic, Deficits and Electromagnetic.
result.label: Econom-ic/ics suffix in economics

result.description: Fires on the word " environments" (also "rooms", "environment") when it ends a noun phrase naming a setting, such as "virtual environments" or "multi-user environments", mostly in education and technology text. Silent on unrelated contexts.
result.label: "environments" after setting modifier

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'ious' (harmon-ious), 'ward' (awk-ward), 'ene', 'icate' (del-icate), completing an adjective. Mostly after a word stem, strongest on 'harmonious'.
result.label: Adjective suffix pieces (-ious, -ward)

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: ' tone' (writing/voice tone), 'cent' inside 'incentive', and 'ps' in 'ellipses'. Mostly detectors of these specific tokens; the contrast shows ' tone' can stay silent at document start.
result.label: tone / incentive 'cent' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' co' (as in coating, copper, cooperation) when it begins a longer word that is continued in the next token. Members are mostly ' co' detectors.
result.label: ' co' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragments ' cal' (calories, calibration, calorimeter) and ' sh' / ' Sh' (shaves, shaped, shifting) when they begin a longer word. Next-token logits favor continuations like 'aping', 'ifts', 'adows'.
result.label: Word-initial cal/sh fragments

result.description: Fires on the token 'stone' in the word 'cornerstone', used figuratively as a foundation of something. Other uses of 'stone' and similar foundation words (heart, foundation) contribute only as inputs.
result.label: 'stone' in cornerstone

result.description: Fires on the word " one" used as a pronoun or numeral (generic "one", "one's", "one of"), often at the start of a sentence after "As". Members are mostly detectors of "one"/"One" itself.
result.label: Token " one" detector

result.description: Fires on ' activities'/' activity' (also 'actions') right after the word "human", mostly in environmental or Anthropocene text about human impact. Silent on general history text without this phrase.
result.label: Human activities (environmental impact)

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens 'g' and 'com' in the middle of a word, where the word continues in the next piece (con-g-estion, under-g-laze, subject-com-plement). Also the 'g' of "e.g.". Silent on the whole word "compliments".
result.label: word-initial fragments 'g' and 'com'
"ural" in "plural"
result.description: Fires on the piece "ural" completing "plural" (pl-ural), mostly in grammar text about singular/plural subjects. Weakly on similar endings like "reflexive". Supported by members detecting "pl" + "ur/ural" and grammar context.
Fires on word-start pieces like ' organiz', ' oper', ' sched' that are followed by the suffix "-ational"/"-uling", in organizational-management text. It predicts the 'ational' continuation.
result.label: Organiz-/oper- before -ational

result.description: Fires on the "I" of the abbreviation "AI" (artificial intelligence) after "A", also weakly on "elligence" in "Intelligence". Silent when "I" starts a word or is in other acronyms like IoT.
result.label: "I" in the acronym AI

result.description: Fires on the noun ending social-movement phrases such as "social justice", "Civil Rights", "civil rights", and "inequality", in text about activism and equality. Silent on "justice" at the start of a document.
result.label: Social justice / civil rights noun

result.description: Fires on the word "plants" (also "Plant"/"plant") in botanical contexts, such as vascular plants, seed plants, or plant hormones. Weak on "plant" in other senses (rooted, planted). Silent in a list of biotech headings.
result.label: Botanical 'plants' token

result.description: Fires on the split-word piece " Elect" at the start of "Electroweak" (e.g. "the Electroweak Theory"), weakly on "elect" in electromagnetism. Predicts name-like suffix tokens. Members are "Elect" detectors in physics text.
result.label: Elect- in Electroweak

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'qu' (and sometimes a hyphen after a prefix like anti-) inside a longer word, as in Antiqu-ity or earthqu-ake, where the word continues. It is silent on 'qu' in Liquid. Predicts suffix pieces such as 'ity'.
result.label: 'qu' mid-word piece (Antiquity, earthquake)

result.description: Fires on past-participle verbs like "directed", "driven", "motivated", "inspired" in "X-directed / driven by / motivated by" constructions, often in discussions of motivation or conflict types. Members detect participles that usually precede "by".
result.label: Participles before "by": directed/driven/motivated

result.description: Fires on 'als' in "deals (with)" and on " dealing", where the word means "is about / treats the topic of". It stays silent on 'als' in "reveals". Predicts "with", "how", "whether" type continuations.
result.label: "deals/dealing with" topic verb

result.description: Fires on "determine"/"determining" and similar verbs like identify, discern, pinpoint, estimate, mostly in technical or mathematical text. It expects an object of measurement or decision, such as whether, the amount, or the optimal value.
result.label: determine / identify verbs in technical text

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "use" (also "application"/"utilization") in technical text, as in "involves the use of X". It stays silent on " of" after other nouns such as "order of" or "product of".
result.label: "of" after "the use"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' catal' (start of catalyst/catalysis/catalytic), in chemistry text, and pushes toward the continuation 'yst'/'yt'. Members are mostly detectors of ' catal'/' Catal', plus some chemistry reaction context.
result.label: ' catal' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' right after the stems "lay" and "mark" (laying, marking), and more weakly after a few other verb stems. It stays silent on 'ing' after stems like threaten, maintain, dissect and correct.
result.label: 'ing' after lay/mark stems
