result.description: Fires on the final piece of a scholar's surname split into tokens, mainly 'eman' in Kahneman and 'sky' in Tversky. It also fires weakly on other name endings like Grover and Carnap. It needs a preceding name fragment in a list of thinkers.
result.label: Kahneman/Tversky surname ending

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "imate" in "Climate" at the start of a heading, and also on suffix pieces like "ity" in "hospitality" and "al". Mainly environmental or topical list headings; peaks are mixed.
result.label: Climate 'imate' and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word "angular" (or "Angular") in physics contexts such as angular momentum, velocity, displacement and acceleration. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. It weakly fires on a few word-start pieces like "altern" and "dio".
result.label: angular (physics) token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Saf' at the start of "Safety" (e.g. "Health and Safety", "Food Safety"), just before the "ety" completion. Members detect safety-related words and word starts.
result.label: ' Saf' piece before "ety"

result.description: Fires on the ending piece (-ve, -ves) of "revolve/revolves" in "revolve around", predicting " around". It stays silent on "crave". Weaker on "encircle". Members detect word-piece endings like cent-ers, -ves.
result.label: revolve(s) around word ending

result.description: Fires on single-letter word pieces (c, i, v, n, r, w) that appear as stray fragments appended after a complete word, often at the start of a glued or bracketed insertion. Silent when the letter is mid-word, as in 'transcends' or 'placements'.
result.label: Stray letter fragment after word

result.description: Fires on the word " or" when it joins two alternatives or introduces an alternate name or synonym, such as "Reformation or ...". Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of " or". Silent on the contrast text.
result.label: " or" joining alternatives

result.description: Fires on the ' poll' piece in "air pollution" and other pollutant words (pollutants, acoustic pollution), where it is the start of a split word. It stays silent on ' poll' in "more polluted environments".
result.label: ' poll' in air pollution

result.description: Fires on the word " factors" (occasionally " factor") when it follows a modifier or quantifier such as "multiple", "several", "major" or "external". It stays silent when " factors" begins the text with no preceding context.
result.label: word " factors" after modifier

result.description: Fires on present-tense or base-form verbs (stayed, travel, perceive, pursue, choose, visit, delve) that follow a plural or "those who/we" subject and expect an object or complement next. Silent on 'age' inside nouns like vintage or homage.
result.label: Verbs after plural/relative subjects

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining abstract measurable quantities in a list or pair (magnitude, frequency, duration and ...), predicting words like frequency, scope, extent. Silent on 'and' in lists of engineering or process items.
result.label: 'and' after measurable-property nouns

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "single" (single-use, single-step, single-atom), where a compound modifier follows. Stays silent on hyphens after other words like equation-, back-, cost-, eco-. Weak secondary hits on other word pieces.
result.label: Hyphen after "single"

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "flow" (e.g. "flow|ing", "flow| of", "flow rate"), predicting water-like continuations. Silent on "ing" in other words like analyzing or mastering, so it needs "flow" just before.
result.label: Suffix or "of" right after "flow"

result.description: Fires on ' and' (occasionally ' or') joining two short academic field or topic names, like "Music and Dance" or "Art and Education" in course or subject listings. Silent on 'and' in technical lists of properties or adjectives.
result.label: 'and' between subject-area names

result.description: Fires on the word " production" as a noun in economic or manufacturing text, such as "food production" or "factors of production". It stays quiet when "production" is used as a modifier before another noun, as in "rapid production times" or "production methods".
result.label: ' production' as head noun

result.description: Fires on the token " vision" in technical computer/machine vision contexts, especially after "stereo", "binocular" or "computer". Members are mostly " vision" detectors. The contrast text has no " vision" token, so the evidence for a condition is thin.
result.label: ' vision' after stereo/computer

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ac' mid-word, mostly in "fast-paced" (fast-p|ac|ed), also in polysaccharides-type words. It stays silent on 'ac' in "Heraclitus". Weaker on other mid-word pieces like 'ies' in "mysteries".
result.label: 'ac' piece in fast-paced

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' right after 'acc' in words like accent, accentuate and accention. It stays silent on 'ent' starting a word or in 'attentive'. Members detect 'acc' and 'ent' pieces, and the logits favour 'uate'.
result.label: 'ent' inside 'accent' words

result.description: Fires on the verb " provides" (also " provide"), mostly when it follows an abstract or formal subject and leads into an object like "a powerful tool" or "the foundation for". It is silent on some uses after subjects such as "it" or "theory".
result.label: ' provides' verb detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' Ba', ' pag' (pagan), ' Bac', ' PM', ' Lö' that begin a longer word or name and need continuation. Silent on 'Ba' inside 'Bacon' after 'Francis'. Members are mostly generic subword/foreign-token detectors.
result.label: Word-initial fragments ' Ba', ' pag'
'pher' in atmospheric
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pher' in "atmospheric" (Atmos-pher-ic), also in similar pieces like "peripherals". Members mostly detect 'pher' itself and predict the suffix 'ic'.
Fires on suffix pieces like 'atic' (mostly in "systematic"), also 'ized' and 'orous', in descriptions of formal, rigorous, structured approaches. Predicts words like formal, definit, cod.
result.label: Systematic/formalized suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the em dash (and similar dashes) in academic or expository prose, typically after a noun phrase where a clause or elaboration follows. Members are mostly dash detectors across variants.
result.label: Em dash in expository prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expect' when it is the start of "expectations" (split into expect + ations). The contrast text without that word piece stays silent. Predicts suffixes like -ations and -ancy.
result.label: expect- stem before -ations

result.description: Fires on ' communication' right after "non-verbal/nonverbal", in text about body language (eye contact, facial expressions, gestures). Silent on 'communication' after other adjectives like effective, professional or compassionate.
result.label: Non-verbal communication

result.description: Fires on "of" inside hyphenated compounds like stream-of-consciousness, state-of-the-art, time-of-flight, out-of-order. Needs a hyphen before "of" in a hyphenated compound; plain "of" elsewhere stays quiet.
result.label: "of" in hyphenated compounds

result.description: Fires on the token ' ground' in all its uses (electrical ground, ground-based, groundwork, dry ground). Members are mostly ' ground' token detectors; the contrast text lacks the word.
result.label: ' ground' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes a comma) right after a person's name in a pair of thinkers or writers, like "Plato and", "Thales and", predicting another name (Aristotle, Pythagoras). Silent on 'and' joining common nouns or concepts.
result.label: 'and' after a person's name

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'par' inside "transparency" (also 'par' in "separable", and 'ific' in "Trans-Pacific"), i.e. a mid-word fragment after "trans"/"se". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: 'par' in transparency

result.description: Fires on a determiner (mostly ' these', also 'the', 'this', 'their') right after the fragment "standing" at the start of a clause, as in "standing these processes is crucial". Silent on ' these' after prepositions or verbs.
result.label: determiner after "standing" fragment

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments mid-word or ordinal suffixes, mainly 'st' (1st century, cry-st-al), 'i' in Fermi, and 'old'. Members detect 'st', 'th' and digits. It seems to need a word-internal or ordinal-suffix position.
result.label: Ordinal and mid-word fragments (st, i)

result.description: Fires on "as" (in "such as") and "like" (and German "wie") when they introduce a list of examples after a plural noun, especially innovations, technologies or advancements. It stays silent on comparative or other uses of "as".
result.label: Example-introducing "such as" / "like"

result.description: Fires on ' growth', mostly as a noun after "personal", "professional" or "emotional" in self-improvement or business text. It also fires weakly on "improvement". Earlier members detect growth, development and success tokens.
result.label: ' growth' after personal/professional

result.description: Fires on a word piece right after a standalone "c" token, e.g. the "n" in c1, c2, ..., cn (linear combination coefficients), and on continuations like c-ement, c-ushion, c-ater, c-ations. It needs the preceding "c" and is silent on "n" elsewhere, as in "yearn".
result.label: Piece after token "c" (cn, cement)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'emes' (also 'eme', 'aph') completing linguistic terms like morphemes, phonemes, and metaphors. It appears in linguistics text, and members track language and sound vocabulary.
result.label: -emes ending in linguistics terms

result.description: Fires on commas, mostly after a word or phrase within a list or clause, such as list items (color, shape, form) or numbers. Silent on some commas after introductory phrases or before "which". Condition is unclear.
result.label: Comma in lists and clauses

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragments ' ag' and ' ep' (agenda, agency, aggression, agile; epic, epidemiology, epistemic) when they begin a longer word split into pieces. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Word-initial ' ag' / ' ep' fragments

result.description: Fires on the modal verb ' can' after an abstract or inanimate subject noun (information, policies, feedback, trust) in expository text, predicting a verb like 'be' or 'lead'. Silent on 'can' after fiction/narrative-setting subjects or at text start.
result.label: Modal ' can' after abstract subject

result.description: Fires on the final 'ment' piece of "Enlightenment" (the Age of Enlightenment, Enlightenment thought). It stays silent on 'ment' in other words such as "abandonment".
result.label: Enlightenment 'ment' suffix

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Fund"/" fund" when it is the start of a longer word, especially "Fundamental(s)" at titles or document starts. It predicts continuations like "ament" and "amental".
result.label: Fund- start of "fundamental"

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' inst', 'enti', ' differenti' that are followed by "-ability" (instability, differentiability), predicting 'abil'/'ability' next. Silent on plain "different".
result.label: inst/differenti before -ability

result.description: Fires on the word " applications" (or " application") as a noun, mostly software or practical uses, e.g. "create applications", "for applications where". It is quiet in some scientific or industrial "applications" at the end of a phrase.
result.label: ' applications' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ologies' (also 'ology') in the word "methodologies". It stays silent on the same suffix in "technologies". Predicts words like selection, procedure, employed.
result.label: methodologies suffix

result.description: Fires on word pieces in agriculture and farming text (agricultural, domestication, cultivation, crop rotation), predicting farming words like crops, tillage, agriculture. Silent when 'ural' appears outside farming context.
result.label: Agriculture and farming word pieces

result.description: Fires on the adverb "often" (mostly the piece "ften" in "Often" at document start, and " often" after "is/are"). Members detect often, sometimes, usually and frequently. The target is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Frequency adverb 'often'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ingu" in "lingu-" words (linguistics, ethnolinguism, sociolinguistic), at the start of a document or inside compounds. Predicts "istic"/"istics" as the continuation.
result.label: "ingu" piece of linguistics words

result.description: Fires on a noun or word-piece right after "a/an/the" in flowery, abstract prose, such as "a series of", "a paragon", "a towering figure". It expects a noun-of phrase to follow. Peak tokens vary.
result.label: Noun after article in ornate prose

result.description: Fires on the 'ying' piece in 'conveying' (communicating information, messages, ideas). Weaker on 'convey' itself. Members detect 'ying' and convey-type words; the contrast is silent on 'transmission'.
result.label: 'ying' in 'conveying'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' completing "express-ive" (expressive performances, expressive interpretation). Much weaker on other -ive adjectives like attentive or persuasive, and silent on productive, passive and collective.
result.label: 'ive' in "expressive"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ab" in the middle of "vocabulary" (also weakly on similar mid-word pieces like " et", " pron", " ill"), predicting a continuation of the word such as "ul". Mostly in language and education text.
result.label: "ab" inside "vocabulary"

result.description: Fires on the token ' shapes', most strongly after geometric adjectives (triangular, round, irregular shapes). It also fires more weakly on the verb use ("shapes our experience"). Members are detectors of shape/shapes and geometry words.
result.label: ' shapes' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb "buy" and "purchase" (and pieces like buy-ers, purch-asing, bu-ying) in market or finance text about buyers and sellers, trading and contracts. It is silent on general derivatives text that doesn't use buying words.
result.label: buy / purchase in market text

result.description: Fires on coordinators (' and', ' or', '-', '/') joining two adjectives or modifiers, e.g. "semi-structured and unstructured", "serifs or sans-serif". Silent on 'and' ending a list of three or more items.
result.label: Coordinator between paired adjectives

result.description: Fires on the piece 'vent' inside words like "intervention(s)", also "unconventional" and "solvent". It needs the word-internal position after a prefix such as inter-, uncon- or sol-, not a standalone word.
result.label: 'vent' piece in intervention

result.description: Fires on " movement" as a head noun after "the" (or an adjective) in scientific explanations, e.g. "the movement of atoms/heat/current". Silent when "movement" starts the text with no preceding determiner.
result.label: "the movement of" noun in science

result.description: Fires on a middle given name (Joseph, Wilhelm, Gö) inside a multi-part name of a philosopher or scientist, when a surname is expected next, as in Friedrich Wilhelm Joseph von Schelling. Silent on plain name lists.
result.label: Middle name in philosopher names

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of nouns (e.g. "planning, design, installation"), especially abstract process or attribute lists. Silent on commas after introductory adverbs or phrases such as "thus," or "ultimately,".
result.label: Comma inside noun lists

result.description: Fires on the word " medical" as a modifier in healthcare-themed text (medical equipment, staff, devices). Members detect healthcare, medicine and patient words. It stays silent on a health-data ethics passage that has no " medical" token.
result.label: ' medical' in healthcare text
' maxim' word-start token
result.description: Fires on the token ' maxim' (maxim, maximization, maximizing, maxims), whether as the noun 'maxim' or the start of 'maximize' words. Predicts suffix pieces like 'izers' and 'agi'. Members are mostly ' maxim' detectors plus optim/minim.

Fires on the token ' L' (space-L), often as a symbol or start of an acronym/name, such as the Lucas number L(n), L1 regularization, or the start of a capitalized word. It is silent on ordinary text without the token.
result.label: Token ' L' detector

result.description: Fires on the word " mobile" (mobile phones, devices, commerce, apps), almost always as a modifier before a noun. Many upstream members are also detectors of " mobile". It slightly promotes next tokens like " phone".
result.label: ' mobile' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word or word piece right after "for" (an adjective or noun start like medium, joint, precise, symmetrical) in a "X for ADJ/NOUN ..." phrase. Predicts "purposes/sake/reasons"-style continuations. Peak tokens are varied.
result.label: Word after "for" in purpose phrases

result.description: Fires on the word "rate"/"rates" as a head noun after a modifier (sampling rate, growth rate, instantaneous rate, rate law). Pushes next-token predictions toward "rates"/"rate". Members are mostly detectors of "rate"/"rates" and similar words like speed.
result.label: rate / rates noun

result.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split, rare surname after "Br" (Br-ou-wer, Br-us-ilov, Brø-n-sted), where the name continues with more pieces. Silent on "ou" in other names like "J.ouer".
result.label: Mid-piece of Br- surnames

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Dynam' as the start of "Dynamics" (Fluid Dynamics, Microsoft Dynamics), with weak activation on a few other tokens like ' slow', ' role', ' gro'. Members are detectors of 'ynam'/'Dynam' pieces.
result.label: ' Dynam' in Dynamics

result.description: Fires on the word piece "iger" inside "refrigerant", "refrigeration" and "refrigerated". It is weakly active on "er" in "minerals". Members are detectors of "iger" and of "ation" in refrigeration.
result.label: iger in refrigerant/refrigeration

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ots' at the end of a split word, as in kn-ots, d-ots, Sp-ots, Rob-ots. Silent on the plain word 'knot', so it needs the 'ots' piece after a preceding fragment.
result.label: 'ots' suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' polar' at the start of words like "polarization" or "polarizers", mostly after "of". Members are mainly ' polar' token detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' polar' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " character" (and "character") in writing about fictional characters and character development, often before a possessive or "development". Members are mostly character-token detectors that push toward -ization/-ised style continuations.
result.label: ' character' in fiction writing

result.description: Fires on the comma right after the phrase "after all" (often following a dash), introducing a justifying clause. Other commas, such as in lists or after other phrases, stay silent or weak.
result.label: Comma after "after all"

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ms' of "rhythms" (also 'mic'/'ythm' in rhythmic/rhythm) in music text. Members detect the rhyth- prefix plus music context. It predicts musical continuations like melody, pattern and flow.
result.label: rhythms word-ending 'ms' after rhyth-
' collabor' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' collabor' (as in collaborate/collaborative), almost always before a suffix like -ate or -ative. Members detect collabor-, cooper-, and related word pieces. Peak tokens are almost all ' collabor'.

Fires on precision-related modifiers such as " precise", " exact", and " precision", mainly before nouns like measurements, quantities, or timing in writing about accuracy and communication. Predicts nouns like specification and details.
result.label: precise / exact / precision words

result.description: Fires on ' ever' (as in "ever-evolving") right after "an", typically in opening phrases like "In an ever-evolving...". Silent on ' ever' after "the". Weaker on other nouns/words after "a/an" such as era, age, region.
result.label: "an ever-" after indefinite article

result.description: Fires on the verb right after a relative "that" (e.g. "ideas that resonate", "phrases that reflect", "conditions that impact"), mostly the start of "reson-" and "reflect". It needs the verb slot of a relative clause.
result.label: Relative-clause verb: resonate/reflect/impact

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' phot' (photography, photon, photogrammetry) and occasionally ' aer' (aerobic), where the word is split and continues with a suffix. Silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly ' phot' detectors.
result.label: phot- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on " in" (or " within") right after a change/variation noun such as changes, fluctuations, shifts, trends, introducing the changed quantity. It stays silent on " in" after "role" or "participate".
result.label: ' in' after change/fluctuation nouns

result.description: Fires on the passive participle 'ized'/'ified' in "characterized by" (also 'defined', 'influenced', 'shaped' by), where the next word is expected to be "by". Silent on 'ized' in verbs like "revolutionized" or "harmonized" that take direct objects.
result.label: "characterized by" participle ending

result.description: Fires on the end of an adjective or head noun inside a "the most ..." superlative phrase (creative, abundant, catastrophic, metallic element), where a comparative continuation like "than ever" or "recorded" may follow. Silent on 'ating' in unrelated words.
result.label: Superlative phrase adjective endings
'order' after hyphen prefix
result.description: Fires on the token 'order' as the second part of a hyphenated or prefixed compound, such as first-order, in-order or disorder. It is weaker on 'periodic'. It stays silent on 'orderly'.

Fires on noun-forming suffix tokens (-ulation, -ption, -ing, reduction) ending technical words in acoustics/soundproofing text, such as absorption, soundproofing, noise reduction. Silent on "manipulation" and "modulation" in audio-software contexts.
result.label: Acoustic/soundproofing term suffixes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' oscill' (as in oscillator, oscillation), peaking in physics text. Upstream members are mostly detectors of this same token. It predicts word continuations like 'ations'.
result.label: ' oscill' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on ' years' (also ' centuries', 'decades') right after a large number or quantity of time, as in "11,700 years ago". It predicts ' ago'. Members detect time-unit words and digit strings.
result.label: Time unit after large number

result.description: Fires on word pieces following a lowercase or capital "d" that continue a word, mostly "ile" in "dilemma", also "end" in "dendritic", "amp" in "damping", "ating" and "ining". It needs the preceding "d" fragment.
result.label: Word piece after split "d" (dilemma)

result.description: Fires on ' then' as a sequencing adverb mid-sentence, after a preceding clause or "and" (e.g. "and then", "; then", "is then validated"). Silent when ' then' starts the text with no prior step.
result.label: Sequential ' then' after prior step

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ence' completing the word "essence", mostly in philosophy text about essence and existence. It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as impermanence, interdependence and permanence.
result.label: 'ence' in "essence"

result.description: Fires on motion verbs, mainly " moving" and " move" (also " travel"), especially in physics text about moving objects, particles, fluids or observers. Members detect move/moving/movement tokens.
result.label: moving / move motion words

result.description: Fires on a word piece (mostly 'ous', also '&') directly after a capital 'R' at the start of a name or acronym, as in R-ous-seau, R-ous-burgh, R&D. It stays silent on 'ous' as an adjective suffix, as in 'ambiguous'.
result.label: Piece after initial R (Rousseau, R&D)

result.description: Fires on the token " stress", most strongly in mechanics/engineering contexts (tensile, compressive stress, stress-strain) and also in other uses. Members are mostly detectors of "stress" and "stresses" at earlier layers.
result.label: ' stress' token detector

result.description: Fires on scope-wide adjectives such as " overall", " general", " larger" and " full" right after "the", before a noun like structure, performance or picture. Mostly appears in economics and analysis text. It predicts nouns like impact, context and scope.
result.label: "the overall" scope adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Mathemat" (start of Mathematical/Mathematics), mostly at the start of a line or heading such as a title list. Weaker on " mathematics" mid-sentence. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' Mathemat' word piece
Word piece 'pt' in skeptic
result.description: Fires on the middle word pieces 'pt'/'ptic' in "skeptic/skeptical/skepticism", after the 'ske' piece. Weak activation on similar mid-word fragments in philosophy/academic words (Descartes, scholars).
Fires on the word-start piece ' ep' (as in epic, epidemic, epistemic, epistolary), where the next piece is usually a suffix like 'ic', 'ide' or 'ist'. Members are mostly ' ep' detectors.
result.label: ' ep' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' evol' (evolve/evolved/evolving), usually after a subject noun, predicting a suffix like 've' or 'ved'. Weaker on similar pieces such as ' del' and ' dram'. Members are mostly ' evol' detectors.
result.label: ' evol' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on verbs and nouns of obtaining, extracting or assessing (obtain, extract, assess, resource, sensor) in technical earth-science, geology and engineering text, often after "for/to/of". Predicts geoscience word pieces like meteor, ge, rock.
result.label: Extraction/obtaining terms in geoscience engineering

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "second" (also "first"), as in second-order logic or second-person. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like non-, decision-, conception-. Predicts continuations like "order" or "person".
result.label: Hyphen after "second"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ad' (Akkad, Leadership), 'on' in "Decolonization", and ' Mass' in "Mass Spectrometry". Mixed word fragments inside longer words or terms; silent on 'ad' in other words like Stradella.
result.label: Mid-word fragments ad/on/Mass

result.description: Fires on the magnitude word ' million' (sometimes ' thousand') right after a number or quantity word, as in "250 million years" or "several thousand stars". Members are detectors of million/billion after numbers.
result.label: million/thousand after a number

result.description: Fires on the word " during" when it follows a noun phrase and introduces a historical period or era (e.g. "during the Middle Ages"). Members are mostly detectors of " during" itself.
result.label: ' during' introducing a time period

result.description: Fires on the word " visual" (or "Visual") as a modifier before a noun, such as visual elements, visual experiences or visualization. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. The contrast text has no "visual" token.
result.label: ' visual' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ive' when it completes the word "supportive" (after "support"). It stays silent on 'ive' in other words such as constructive, attentive, cohesive.
result.label: 'ive' in "supportive"

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis ' (' that follows a noun or noun phrase in a list or description, where a parenthetical such as an abbreviation, example, or number is about to start. It stays silent on a line-initial ' (' and after some analysis phrases.
result.label: Parenthesis after noun phrase

result.description: Fires on "ver" inside "maneuver(ing)", and more weakly on "navigate" or "negotiating". These are words about steering or maneuvering through something. It stays silent on "ver" in "fever" or a bare "ver".
result.label: "ver" in maneuver(ing)

result.description: Fires on the verb " transformed" (passive or active, e.g. "were transformed into", "has transformed the landscape"). Members are mostly detectors of "transformed" and similar past participles like identified or created.
result.label: ' transformed' verb detector
'ist' in 'trans-ist-ors'; ' arise'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ist' mainly inside 'transistors' (after 'trans'), and on ' arise' before 'from'. Weaker on other mid-word pieces after 'trans' (e.g. 'par' in transparency).
Fires on the 'ism' piece inside "seism-" words (seismic, seismograph, seismology). It stays silent on 'ism' in paleomagnetism, so it needs the "se" prefix. It weakly fires on 'war' in "dwarf".
result.label: 'ism' in seismic words

result.description: Fires on the verb "focus" and on "concent"/"rate" in "concentrate" when used as a verb meaning to direct attention, predicting "on". Weaker on other "focus on" uses.
result.label: focus / concentrate (on)

result.description: Fires on the token 'cos' as a word piece, mostly in "viscosity" and "ecosystem" (also the trig function), with a weaker hit on ' golden' in "golden standard". Members are mostly 'cos' detectors.
result.label: 'cos' word piece (viscosity, ecosystem)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' dr' when it starts a word like drilling, drill or drought, after a preceding word. It stays silent when ' dr' is the first token of the document, so it needs a preceding context token.
result.label: ' dr' word-start piece (drilling)

result.description: Fires on the particle ' up' (occasionally ' down') after motion or change verbs like moves, curves, bounce back, speed, scale, where it is a directional adverb. It pushes toward suffixes like 'wards'. Silent on 'calling up' (telephone sense).
result.label: directional ' up' after motion verbs

result.description: Fires on the '.,' token in the abbreviation "e.g.," (also "i.e.,") when it opens a parenthetical list of examples, such as "(e.g., notebook)". Weakly fires on "such as" and "includes both".
result.label: "e.g.," example-introducer

result.description: Fires on the piece 'acci' in "Fibonacci", inside mathematical text about Fibonacci numbers and sequences. Members detect 'acci' and preceding 'Fibon' pieces, plus math-topic context.
result.label: Fibonacci 'acci' token

result.description: Fires on ' and' (occasionally ' or') joining two plural or technical nouns, often at the end of a short noun phrase such as "actuators and". It stays silent on many other ' and' contexts, and the contrast does not show clearly what separates them.
result.label: Noun-coordinating ' and'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ography' completing the word "chromatography". Upstream members detect the chromat- prefix and analytical-chemistry context (analytes, separation). Only weak activation on other words.
result.label: 'ography' in chromatography
Mid-word fragments in technical terms
result.description: Fires on word-internal pieces like 'id', 'ic', 'ell', 'c' in the middle of multi-token technical words (St-ell-ar, nucle-ic, undec-id-ability), where the word is unfinished and likely continues with a suffix.
Fires on the token ' fruit' (occasionally ' Black'), mostly when it begins a compound or modifier such as 'fruit slicer' or 'fruit pairs'. Members detect fruit, seed, and food words.
result.label: ' fruit' token detector

result.description: Fires on abstract action nouns like "realization", "recognition", "establishment" right after "the" (or "real-"), heading a following "of ..." phrase. Silent on "-ization" in words like digitization, globalization, synchronization.
result.label: Abstract noun after 'the', before 'of'

result.description: Fires on the word " problem" (also problems, and a few word pieces like cha-, thre-), mostly in educational "problem-solving" or "problem types/statement" text. Predicts continuations like "-solving". Members are mostly " problem" detectors.
result.label: ' problem' in problem-solving contexts

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in linguistics/math terms, mainly 'omorph' (allomorph, homomorphism), also 'ph' in Morph- and 'ographic' in Orthographic. It pushes toward suffixes like -ological, -ology, -etic.
result.label: morph- word pieces in technical terms

result.description: Fires on ' just' right after a copula verb (is/are/was) as an adverb, as in "is just as important". It stays silent on "not just" / "more than just".
result.label: ' just' after is/are (not "not just")

result.description: Fires on nuclear-physics vocabulary word pieces, mainly ' neut' (before -ron), ' emission', ' Rad(iation)' and ' nucle', in texts about neutrons, radiation and nuclear processes. Silent on unrelated science text.
result.label: Nuclear physics terms: neutron, emission

result.description: Fires on abstract quality nouns such as " efficiency", "-ization" (miniaturization) and "-ability" endings, mostly in engineering and technical text, often after "for", "in" or "of". Predicts word endings or following nouns.
result.label: Efficiency / -ization technical nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mod' when it begins a longer word such as modular, modulation or modulo, mid-sentence. It stays silent when ' mod' is the first token of the document. Members are mostly ' mod' token detectors.
result.label: ' mod' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word fragments that start a longer word, mainly 'ipp' (stippling, ripples) and ' puzz' (puzzle), where a suffix like -le/-les/-ling is expected next. Predicts those suffixes.
result.label: Mid-word 'ipp'/'puzz' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Pol' at the start of "Polymer" headings, where it is the first piece of a longer word. Weaker on other word-start pieces like ' pol' in polysemy.
result.label: ' Pol' in Polymer

result.description: Fires on the word "index" (and Index, indexing) as a noun or stem, mostly in database and technical text. Members detect index/indexes tokens plus database context such as MySQL, tree and DBMS. Predicts suffixes like -ation and -ing.
result.label: " index" word detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin a longer word or name, mainly ' Mark' in Markov, 'ald' in heraldic/Heraldry, and ' Tim' or ' feed' pieces. It expects a suffix to follow (e.g. 'ov', 'ic', 'ry'), not a whole-word use.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Mark(ov), Her-ald(ry)

result.description: Fires on the word " questions" as a noun, mostly after adjectives or verbs like "asking probing/open-ended/reflective questions". Members are mostly detectors of "questions", "ask" and "answer". The contrast text has no such word.
result.label: ' questions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " heat" (also the "at" of "Heat"), strongest in physics contexts such as "specific heat" and "latent heat". Weaker on "heat flow" or "absorb more heat". Members are mostly heat/thermal/temperature detectors.
result.label: heat in thermodynamics terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' neut' at the start of neutron/neutrino, in physics text. Members are mostly ' neut' token detectors. It predicts continuations like 'ron' and 'rino'.
result.label: ' neut' in neutron/neutrino

result.description: Fires on the ending pieces "ations", "ibration" or "ational" when they complete the word "vibration(s)" or "vibrational" in physics or math text. It stays silent on "-ations" in other words such as examinations, deformations or foundations.
result.label: vibration word endings

result.description: Fires on the word "interaction(s)" (also "interactional", occasionally "Exchange"), mostly in academic text about human or social interactions. Members are detectors of interaction/relationship words.
result.label: interaction(s) word detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cre' at the start of a split word (creativity, creator, creep) and predicts continuations like 'ativity', 'ape', 'ative'. Members mostly detect ' cre' or similar word-start pieces like ' innov'.
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'er' right after 'coh' (coherence, coherent), and weakly on 'cular' in 'molecular'. It stays silent on 'er' in other words like polymer or pioneer.
result.label: 'er' in 'coh-er-ence'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'uster' in austerity, 'astic' in elastic/inelastic, 'vik' in Bolshevik, and 'ity' after auster. Needs the specific word context; members detect 'astic' and 'uster' pieces.
result.label: Word pieces in austerity/elastic/Bolshevik

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces such as 'alous' (anomalous, Anabalous), 'ic' (Gothic) and 'ific' in the middle of multi-token words. Upstream members detect word fragments like anom-, Goth-, incons-.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (-alous, -ic)

result.description: Fires on morphology terms in linguistics text, mainly ' suffix', infix 'ix', 'emes', and 'letters', especially in lists like "prefixes, infixes, suffixes". Silent on general grammar text about nouns and verbs.
result.label: Morphology terms: suffix, infix, morphemes

result.description: Fires on semicolons separating items in a semicolon-delimited list or series of parallel clauses, after a list item or clause. Mostly silent on semicolons in some other contexts, such as a slash-joined planning list.
result.label: Semicolon separating list items

result.description: Fires on ' UI', ' Content'/' content' and 'X' (UX) as nouns in design/digital-media text, such as "UI Design" or "Content Management". Members detect interface, user, layout and content words.
result.label: UI / content design terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' am' at the start of chemistry terms like amines, amination, amino and ammonolysis. It is a detector of that token, with a few weak hits on '-' in 'coal-fired'.
result.label: ' am' in amine/amino words

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'us' when it completes the word "nucleus" (nucle|us), in physics and biology text. It stays silent on 'us' in the odd spelling "nuclupus", so it needs the nucle- prefix.
result.label: 'us' ending "nucleus"

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis (or bracket) that ends a short parenthetical, often a qualifier or variable, right before a continuing word like "and", "or", "as well as". Silent on some longer parentheticals.
result.label: Closing parenthesis after short parenthetical

result.description: Fires on ' don' (also ' do', ' didn') as the negated auxiliary in "don't"/"didn't", after a subject like "they" or "you", where n't follows. Members mostly detect the ' don' token, including the "donate" word start.
result.label: Auxiliary "don't" after subject

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ol' (and 'ult', 'et') inside compounds starting with "soci(o)-", such as sociolinguistic or socioc-ultural, predicting the next piece of the compound. Silent on 'ol' in "scholars".
result.label: Piece after "soci-" in sociolinguistic

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that begin a longer word split into pieces, mainly ' ded' (deductive), ' rel' (relatable), ' Pon' (Ponens), and ' gam' (gamut). Members are mostly detectors of these fragments.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: ded, rel, Pon

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing a technical term, especially "Teleportation" in quantum/physics titles, after pieces like "Teleport". Silent on 'ation' in words like fabrication, innovation, generation.
result.label: 'ation' ending Teleportation

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Quant"/" quant" (Quantum, quantitative, quantized, quantifier), often at the start of a heading line. It pushes toward suffixes like "itative", "ifiable" and "ization".
result.label: Quant- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' the' (also this/these/art) right after a form of "master" (mastering, masters, mastered), where the next word is a skill or subject being mastered. Silent on 'the' after other verbs. Logits favor master-like word pieces.
result.label: Determiner after "master" verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' cop' when it begins a longer word such as copolymer, coprime or copious, i.e. a split-off prefix that continues into a technical word. Members detect ' cop' and similar prefixes (mit, sem).
result.label: ' cop' prefix in split words

result.description: Fires on the token ' formula', mostly in math text (distance formula, midpoint formula, quadratic formula). Members are mainly detectors of 'formula' and 'equation' in earlier layers. Silent on unrelated geometry text without the word.
result.label: ' formula' token detector

result.description: Fires on plural word endings such as 'ens' in gardens and 'als' in festivals, at the end of plural nouns for places or events (gardens, festivals, venues). Weaker on other plural endings like beliefs and traditions.
result.label: Plural noun endings: gardens, festivals

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' vern' (vernacular), ' Norman', ' verm', ' Geoff' in history-of-language and medieval/Renaissance text. Members include Latin/Renaissance/medieval topic detectors and a ' vern' detector.
result.label: vern- / Norman in language history

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ros' (sometimes 'ro') inside the word "corrosion"/"corrosive", after the prefix "cor". It stays silent when 'ros' starts a word without "cor" before it.
result.label: 'ros' inside "corrosion"

result.description: Fires on the token " account" (also "accounts") in accounting, finance and "account for" uses, often before "-ing" or "-ability". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' account' token detector

result.description: Fires on the ending piece (-es, -ation, -ing) of a word in a list of morphological terms like "prefixes, suffixes, infixes" in linguistics text. Silent on 'es' in unrelated words like capes or heroes.
result.label: Affix-term plural endings in morphology

result.description: Fires on the word ' communication' (also 'Communic|ation'), in noun-modifier slots like "quantum communication" or "electronic communication". It predicts following nouns such as systems, channels, protocols and networks.
result.label: ' communication' token detector

result.description: Fires on " the" right after "laid"/"laying"/"setting" in "laid the groundwork/foundation"; weakly after verbs like "shaping" or "feeds". It predicts foundation, basis, corner. It stays silent on " the" after other verbs or prepositions.
result.label: "the" after "laid" (groundwork)

result.description: Fires on the token right after "during" (" the", a space before a year, or the "s" of a decade like 1920s), where a time period or era is expected next. It predicts period words such as periods, hours and phases.
result.label: Token after "during", before a period

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' therm' (thermodynamic, thermometer, thermistor, thermoset) when it starts a longer word, predicting continuations like 'odynamic' or 'ometer'. Barely fires on other word-initial pieces such as ' pot' in 'potatoes'.
result.label: ' therm' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' instant', ' extra', ' simultane' that are likely followed by a suffix (instantaneous, simultaneous, extraction), pushing towards continuations like 'aneous' and 'ity'. Mostly in physics/technical text.
result.label: instant/extra/simultane word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " ideal" (rarely " perfect") in idealism, ideal gas, idealized and "the ideal X" contexts. It is a token detector, and the logits favour suffix pieces such as "ized" and "ization".
result.label: ' ideal' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'and' or 'in' right after "flexible" or "flexibility" (e.g. "flexible and resilient", "flexibility in work hours"), predicting adaptability words like accommodate, adapt, flexible. Silent on 'in' after "collaborative".
result.label: Connector after flexible/flexibility

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' k' (a word-initial fragment or a variable), mostly where it begins a word such as ketones, kinetics or kitchens. It predicts word continuations like 'itch', 'inet' and 'urg'.
result.label: ' k' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'il' mainly in "fossil" (also stencil, Mercantilism), and sometimes on ' chapter'. It stays silent on 'il' in "resilient". Members are mostly 'il' and ' foss' detectors.
result.label: 'il' in fossil

result.description: Fires on the token "water", often as the second piece of compounds like fresh-water, salt-water, rain-water or ground-water, and in water-related text. Members are mostly detectors of water/sea/ocean tokens.
result.label: "water" token, especially in compounds

result.description: Fires on ' we' (occasionally ' you'/' they') when it begins a relative clause right after a noun, as in "the words we choose" or "each language we speak". It stays quiet on ' we' as a main-clause subject or after "as if".
result.label: ' we' starting a relative clause

result.description: Fires on the 'xt' piece inside "juxtaposition/juxtaposes" (and the ' ju' start), mostly in literary-technique text. Weaker activation on other word-start pieces like ' ver' in "verbs".
result.label: 'xt' in juxtapose

result.description: Fires on word pieces ' conj' and 'pos' inside the grammar terms "conjunctions" and "prepositions", in English grammar-teaching text. Silent on a bare "conjunctions or" at the start of a document.
result.label: Grammar terms: conj-/prepos- pieces

result.description: Fires on the nouns " effect", " effects" and " impact" (causal influence), often in statistical or research text. It is mostly silent when "effects" starts a document with no preceding context. Logits favor " on" as the next token.
result.label: effect / impact noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'on' inside the word "spintronics" (Spintr-on-ics). It stays silent on 'on' in other words like "photon" or "phenomenon".
result.label: 'on' in spintronics

result.description: Fires on "wider", "broader" (the 'ader' piece after "bro") and "global" as scope-widening adjectives before an abstract noun (changes, social transformations, financial crisis). It needs an adjective-before-noun slot about scale or scope.
result.label: wider / broader / global scope adjectives

result.description: Fires on the piece "ote" inside words like nanotechnology, Geotechnical, Remote, biotech, and on the word " remote" (remote sensing, remote work). Silent on other nano- words such as nanophysics.
result.label: "ote" piece and " remote"

result.description: Fires on the word "energy"/"Energy", most strongly on "Energy" as a list-heading item in topic outlines (Energy Auditing, Energy Modeling), and also mid-sentence before nouns like usage, supply or conservation. Silent in other topic lists.
result.label: Energy word detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' und' (and similar word-start pieces like 'und', 'cr', 'ind') when it starts a word such as undermines or undulates, and also on German 'und'. Predicts continuations like 'istance', 'es', 'istant'.
result.label: ' und' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on "on" in "hands-on" and on "active"/"young" after encouraging/promote verbs, in education and pedagogy text. It predicts participation or engagement words next. It stays silent on "on" inside names like Pokémon.
result.label: Hands-on / active learning in education

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Aqu"/" aqu" (aqueduct, aquifer, aquatic, Aquinas, Aquitaine), when it is a fragment that begins a longer word. It also fires weakly on similar fragments like "mar" and "Angle".
result.label: Aqu- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' times' in any sense: multiplication ("5 times 4"), multiples ("3 times"), access/refresh times, and historical eras ("ancient times"). Members are mostly ' times' detectors plus similar words like periods and moments.
result.label: ' times' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' that' used as a demonstrative pronoun or determiner, especially in comparisons ("similar to that of", "greater than that of", "like that friend"). Silent when 'that' is a relativizer or complementizer.
result.label: Demonstrative 'that' in comparisons

result.description: Fires on the token " data" (and "Data") as a modifier or head in data-related phrases such as "data analysis", "data-driven", "big data". Members are mostly detectors of " data" itself. The contrast has no " data" token.
result.label: ' data' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " sust" (start of sustainable/sustainability), mostly after "environmental" or "ecological". It is silent on some " sust" after verbs like "incorporating" or "promote", so context matters.
result.label: sust- after environmental/ecological

result.description: Fires on the 've' piece in "eigenvectors" and on related linear-algebra words like "eigenvalues", "ctors", "paces", within matrix and vector-space text. Members are mostly linear-algebra topic detectors.
result.label: eigenvector/eigenvalue linear algebra tokens

result.description: Fires on word endings like -ized/-ize/-ization when they complete "special" (specialized, specialize, specialization). It stays silent on the same suffix after other stems such as standardized or stabilized.
result.label: Suffix after "special"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ized' right after 'personal' (also individual-, special-, custom-), where the next word is a noun like experiences or recommendations. Silent on 'ized' in words like unauthorized or utilized.
result.label: personalized suffix 'ized'

result.description: Fires on ' important' as the predicate adjective after "it is" / "is" (e.g. "it is important to note"). Stays silent on superlative "most important" as a noun modifier. Weaker on vital, essential, crucial.
result.label: Predicate "is important" adjective

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "itional" completing "Propositional" (also "Biconditional", "Unconditional") in formal logic text. It fires more weakly on "itional" in other words, like "nutritional".
result.label: "itional" in Propositional/logic terms

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens mid-word such as 'liqu' in solid-liquid, 'par' in transparency/preparation/separable, and 'ced' in unprecedented. Seems to need an incomplete word start inside science/technical text.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: liqu, par, ced

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of reasoning/analysis verbs (' dedu' in deduction, ' ver' in verifying, ' analyz', ' determ') in abstract math/logic/philosophy text, mid-word before the suffix is completed.
result.label: Reasoning-word prefixes in math/logic text

result.description: Fires mainly on " patient" as a modifier in healthcare text (patient-centered, patient safety, patient data), and less on word pieces like "asure" in "treasure". Mostly a patient detector with a minor secondary token.
result.label: ' patient' in healthcare text

result.description: Fires on "ken" in "likened (to)" and on " similar" in "is similar to", plus "kin" in "akin to". It marks comparison phrases that introduce an analogy, before "to".
result.label: Analogy phrase: likened/similar/akin to

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " scal" (as in scalability, scalable, scalars), and weakly on " coast" before "-al". It predicts suffix pieces like "ability". Members detect "scal" and similar prefix pieces.
result.label: " scal" prefix of scalability

result.description: Fires on the word " failure" (also " errors", " fail") as a noun for things going wrong, in technical and general discussion. Members are detectors of failure/fail tokens across earlier layers. Silent on contrast text about quality control without that word.
result.label: failure / errors noun

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Pro" (also "pro") when it begins a longer word, such as "Probability", "Proton" or "Protocol". It is strongest at the start of a line or title. It pushes toward continuations like "port" and "finite".
result.label: Pro- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "act" when it completes "Imp|act" (as in "Environmental Impact Assessment"). It is quiet on other "act" contexts such as a different word split, and members detect "act" and "Imp" pieces.
result.label: "act" piece in "Impact"

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ence' and 'ing' in "adherence" / "adhering" (before "to standards/regulations"). It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as "excellence". Logits favour "strict", "strictly", "standard".
result.label: adherence / adhering word ending

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cogn' (start of "cognitive/cognition") in academic text, typically after an adjective or preposition. Members are detectors of ' cogn' and related science word starts like psych, sexual, visual.
result.label: ' cogn' word-start detector

result.description: Fires on the word " concept" (also "cept" in "Conceptual") when it follows "the" as a head noun, as in "the concept of X". Silent when "concept" starts the text without a preceding "the".
result.label: "the concept of" noun

result.description: Fires on the noun after "mental" (mostly " states", also "caus" in "mental causation") in philosophy-of-mind text about mind-body relations. Silent on general consciousness text without this phrase.
result.label: "mental states" / causation noun

result.description: Fires on the word after an adverb like "primarily/largely/mainly" in descriptions of what a society or activity is based on, driven by, or governed by (" based", " driven", " by"). Silent on "based" without such a preceding adverb.
result.label: Word after "primarily/largely" (based, driven)
Greenhouse 'house' piece
result.description: Fires on the token 'house' when it completes "greenhouse" (as in greenhouse gas/effect), in climate text. It predicts ' gas' next. It is silent on general climate text without that word piece.
Fires mostly on the suffix "ness" (especially in "wellness", also fitness, illness) and on " fish" in fisheries-type words. Members are mostly "ness" detectors. Weak firing on " describing".
result.label: "ness" suffix and " fish"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "acc" in "vaccine(s)", after the "v" piece. Members are mostly detectors of this "acc" token in vaccine contexts.
result.label: "acc" in vaccine

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ist' in "twist" (also twisty, twisting) after 'tw', mostly in writing about plot and narrative. It is silent on 'ist' in other words, such as "undistracted".
result.label: 'ist' in "twist"

result.description: Fires on the stem of verbs like "utilize" and "incorporate" (also "emphasize", "exploit") right after a relative pronoun such as "that" or "which". It is the word-start piece before the -ize or -ate ending.
result.label: util-/incorpor- verb stem after "that"

result.description: Fires on the token ' consumption' (energy, economic, goods consumption) in all its appearances. Members are mostly ' consumption'/' consume' detectors plus a few unrelated word-piece detectors. Predicts next tokens like patterns/habits.
result.label: ' consumption' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " gas" (also " Gas"), mostly in physics and chemistry or oil and gas text about gas properties and behavior. Members are mostly detectors of the same token in earlier layers.
result.label: The word "gas"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' hum' when it starts a longer word, mostly "humidity" (also humidifier, humorous). Members are detectors of ' hum' and similar word-start fragments. It predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' hum' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ary' in pituitary, 'cient' in Ancient, 'it', 'ic', mainly in biology/science terms. Stays silent on 'ary' in evolutionary and eukaryotic. Peaks are varied word fragments.
result.label: Word fragments in pituitary, Ancient

result.description: Fires on the word piece "action" completing "Inter-action" (also "Interactions"), and more weakly on " exit" and a few other pieces. Members detect "Inter" + "active"/"action" pieces.
result.label: Inter-"action" word piece
'ic' in "biconditional" after 'b'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ic' right after a word-initial 'b' in "biconditional" (b-ic-onditional). It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as logic, intricately or mathematic.

Fires on the word piece ' p' as a standalone token, often the start of a split word like "pandering" or "pivotal", or a variable like p in pH. It stays quiet on some ' p' tokens, such as those right after a period or in "pragmatics", "paved".
result.label: Split-word ' p' token

result.description: Fires on the token ' goals' (also 'objectives' pieces) right after an adjective like clear, measurable or long-term, in management and planning text about setting objectives. Members are mostly goal/target/objective detectors.
result.label: ' goals' after modifiers in planning text

result.description: Fires on the word " tools" (also " tool"), especially as a plural noun after phrases like "variety of", "use of", or "appropriate". Members are mostly detectors of "tools". Predicts next words like kit, box, used, employed.
result.label: Word "tools"

result.description: Fires on the word "cost(s)" and related money-expense words (expenses, overhead) in business or accounting text about costs. It is silent on "production costs" in a regulatory list context. It pushes toward cost-related continuations.
result.label: cost / expenses noun

result.description: Fires on a comma inside a list of parallel nouns, such as fields, disciplines or elements (physics, engineering, science, art), after a list item that is followed by more items. It is silent on commas after clause adverbs or relative clauses.
result.label: Comma in noun lists

result.description: Fires on music genre names (country, rock, roll, punk, grunge, soul) in lists or discussions of musical styles; predicts further genre words like punk, jazz, hip. Silent on non-music text.
result.label: Music genre names

result.description: Fires on the word piece " scatter" (as in scattering, scatterer) in physics text about Thomson, Rayleigh and Compton scattering. It predicts word-ending suffixes such as "ing" or "ical". Members are mostly detectors of " scatter".
result.label: ' scatter' word stem

result.description: Fires on the word " further", most strongly as an adverb after a passive auxiliary ("was further developed", "can be further segmented"), and also in "any further information". It predicts verbs like developed, stated, informed.
result.label: ' further' after passive auxiliary

result.description: Fires on indefinite/quantifier pronouns like "something", "nothing", "much", "little", "everything" when they act as the object or subject of a clause, e.g. "there's something". Silent on "something" after "when" or "of". Predicts "else".
result.label: Indefinite pronouns something/nothing

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Ne' when it begins "Neural" in machine-learning terms such as "Convolutional Neural Networks" or "Recurrent Neural Networks". It is weaker on "Neolithic". It stays quiet on ordinary text.
result.label: ' Ne' of Neural Networks

result.description: Fires on forms of "bring" (bringing, bring, brought, brings), and weakly on similar verbs like put or adds, where a particle such as "about", "forth" or "together" is likely to follow. Members are mostly detectors of "bring" forms.
result.label: Forms of "bring" verb

result.description: Fires on the token 'y' inside the word "recycling"/"recyclable" (rec|y|cling), predicting 'cling' next. Weak activation on a few other word-internal pieces such as 'abs' and 'embassy'.
result.label: 'y' in rec-y-cling

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Cr" in "Francis Crick" (Watson and Crick, DNA double helix), as a name-start fragment awaiting "ick". Members include Cr/cr detectors and genetics/DNA topic features.
result.label: Cr in Francis Crick

result.description: Fires on the word " excitement" (occasionally " susp" of suspense) in text about pacing and storytelling techniques that build excitement or suspense. Members mostly detect excitement/tension-type emotion words; it pushes toward verbs like "builds" and "increases".
result.label: excitement in narrative pacing text

result.description: Fires on the word " ensure", most strongly in purpose clauses like "To ensure …" at the start of a sentence. It weakly fires on other verbs after "to", such as "provide". Members detect ensure/ensures/ensuring.
result.label: " ensure" after "to"
'ing' in employing/deploying
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' ending gerunds like employ-ing and deploying (loy-ing), as in "employing X" or "deploying these". It stays silent on 'ing' after other stems such as partitioning, impacting, crafting.

Fires on the final piece of "symphony" and "orchestra" (sym-phony, or-chestra), often in metaphors comparing systems to an orchestra. Predicts orchestral or music continuations. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: symphony / orchestra word endings

result.description: Fires on the token "energy" in "high-energy" (particle beams, physics, conditions). Silent on "energy" in "energy-efficient", so it needs the preceding "high-" compound. Supported by energy/physics detectors upstream.
result.label: energy after "high-"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'if' inside multi-piece words such as aqu-if-ers, B-if-urcation and sher-if. Silent when the word is split differently (e.g. "acre…"). Members are mostly 'if' detectors plus an ' aqu' detector.
result.label: 'if' inside words (aquifers)

result.description: Fires on the word " concurrent" as an adjective before nouns like systems, programming, or processes, mostly in computing text. Members detect related words such as parallel, concurrency, isolated and independent.
result.label: ' concurrent' in computing text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (th, ib, oth, ath, on) inside technical Greek-derived words after a "ph"/"ph-" start, like diphthong, hydrophobic, phonetics. It is silent on ordinal "th" such as 15th.
result.label: Mid-word piece in ph- technical words
